0435ad8540c85bd6.description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

As a Client Service Supervisor – Fund Accounting, you will oversee the mutual fund accounting activities of several large, complex funds and/or a group of funds. The position ensures the firm's clients receive accurate and timely data and serves as a point of escalation for complex client issues.

If you are looking to push your career to the next level, introduce yourself by submitting your resume.

Key responsibilities include:

Field and respond to client inquiries and escalated issues, and serve as the point person for your assigned senior level client contacts.

Manage and resolve incidents by having the capability to efficiently analyze the validity of transactions, valuation impacts, and any other portfolio impacting aspects such as portfolio hedging, performance fees, or dilution levies, while ensuring escalation of issues based on set tolerances.

Coordinate and follow up on client meetings and deliverables.

Work closely with internal clients in Operations and Treasury and Markets to ensure timely resolution of client inquiries and improvement of service levels.

Develop key internal relationships to proactively aid in the resolution of client issues.

As part of the oversight and control responsibilities, ensure the accurate and timely valuation of accounting records and reports through analysis and review of fund accounting activities.

Qualifications:

Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience in similar role

You should be highly team oriented, committed to operating in the best interests of the company and the team and passionate about what you do

You will need to be experienced in daily mutual fund accounting activities and have a strong understanding of portfolio impacting aspects such as portfolio hedging, performance fees, or dilution levies.

What We Offer:

A collaborative environment that enables you to step outside your role to add value wherever you can

Direct access to clients, information and experts across all business areas around the world

Opportunities to grow your expertise, take on new challenges, and reinvent yourself—without leaving the firm

A culture of inclusion that values each employee’s unique perspective

High-quality benefits program emphasizing good health, financial security, and peace of mind

Rewarding work with the flexibility to enjoy personal and family experiences at every career stage

Volunteer opportunities to give back to your community and help transform the lives of others

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development—so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice—creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often—pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Lead Site Reliability Engineer (AI/ML)

As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer at Mastercard, you'll play a pivotal role focusing on the seamless deployment, operationalization, and continuous improvement of our AI/ML solutions. You'll be instrumental in translating AI models from development to production, ensuring they deliver tangible business value, operate efficiently, and meet key performance indicators.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead the E2E deployment and operationalization of AI/ML models and solutions, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and integrated seamlessly into existing business processes
• Establish and maintain robust monitoring frameworks for deployed AI solutions. Proactively identify performance bottlenecks, data drifts, and other issues, and drive their resolution to ensure optimal business outcomes
• Work closely with business stakeholders, AI Engineers, and product teams to understand business requirements, define success metrics for AI solutions, and ensure deployed models are directly contributing to key business objectives
• Implement and champion MLOps best practices, automation strategies, and efficient workflows to streamline the deployment lifecycle of AI models, from experimentation to production
• Collaborate with risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure all AI deployments adhere to internal policies, regulatory requirements, and ethical AI principles
• Lead the response to operational incidents related to deployed AI models, conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventative measures
Qualifications
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, or a related field
• Experience: Minimum of 8+ years of experience in AI/ML operations, MLOps, DevOps, or a related role with a strong focus on deploying and managing AI/ML solutions in production environments.
• Technical Skills:
o Solid understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle, from data preparation and model training to deployment and monitoring.
o Experience with one of the cloud platforms and their AI/ML services
o Proficiency in scripting and
o Familiarity with containerization technologies
o Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for machine learning models.
o Experience with monitoring tools for AI/ML solutions
o Understanding of data governance, data quality, and data security principles relevant to AI/ML
• Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into technical requirements for AI solutions, and articulate the business value of AI deployments
• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills
• Ability to effectively bridge the gap between technical and business teams
• Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives, drive cross-functional projects, and influence outcomes without direct authority
• Strong understanding of operational processes and a passion for optimizing them

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

We are searching for a Head of Product Operations to own the operational and technical backbone of our EU product function. This is a hands-on player coach role. Instead of focusing on traditional people management, you will act as an individual contributor and technical leader, building the infrastructure, automated workflows, and AI augmented processes that make great product work repeatable.

You will treat our internal workflows as your product, maximising strategic headspace by automating repetitive tasks, optimising our tech stack, and introducing cutting edge AI tools into the daily product lifecycle. Working closely with regional teams and North American counterparts, you will align and scale these workflows to build a cohesive, global product operating system.

Product Operations at Ford Credit

Product Operations at Ford Credit is a strategic enablement function focused on accelerating delivery, driving product maturity, and reducing operational friction across our EU portfolio.

You Will Drive Four Progressive Pillars Of Product Enablement

Tooling & Automation: Administering and configuring our core product stack (Jira, Airtable, Confluence, Miro) to ensure automated, standardised collaboration across EU product lines in alignment with global strategies.

Ways of Working & Engineering Alignment: Designing shared processes for planning, estimation, and execution. This pillar addresses the human and behavioral mechanics of delivery, transforming how teams engage and collaborate to resolve operational friction.

AI Ops for PDLC: Integrating Generative AI, prompt engineering, and automated agents into the Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) to automate documentation, user stories, and feedback synthesis.

Frictionless Compliance: Partnering with Legal, Risk, and Compliance to embed European financial regulations directly as automated guardrails within our tooling.

Product Tooling & Automation



- Own and optimise the Product technology ecosystem, including Jira, Airtable, Confluence, Miro, and emerging platforms.
- Design, configure, and automate workflows that improve collaboration, governance, and delivery consistency.
- Standardise tools and processes across European product teams while aligning with global Product Operations practices.

Product Operating Model & Ways of Working



- Define and continuously improve the operating model for product planning, prioritisation, estimation, and execution.
- Drive adoption of consistent product management practices that increase transparency, efficiency, and cross-functional collaboration.
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Design, and Delivery teams to remove operational bottlenecks and improve execution.

AI-Enabled Product Operations



- Lead the adoption of Generative AI across the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC).
- Introduce AI-powered workflows, prompt engineering, and automation to streamline activities such as documentation, user story creation, research synthesis, and reporting.
- Evaluate and implement emerging AI capabilities that improve team productivity and decision-making.

Governance & Compliance



- Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance teams to embed European regulatory requirements into product workflows and tooling.
- Design automated governance processes that reduce manual effort while ensuring compliance by design.

What You'll Bring



- Proven experience in Product Operations, Product Management Operations, or a similar strategic enablement role.
- Deep expertise with modern product management tooling and workflow automation.
- Experience designing scalable operating models and improving cross-functional ways of working.
- Strong understanding of AI applications within product development and operational excellence.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across regional and global teams.
- A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for building efficient, scalable product organisations.

Why Join Us

Join Ford Credit at a pivotal moment as we transform the way we build and deliver products across Europe. You'll have the opportunity to shape our Product Operations function, lead the adoption of AI-enabled ways of working, and influence how high-performing product teams operate at scale. Working with colleagues across Europe and North America, you'll play a key role in driving innovation, operational excellence, and the future of digital product delivery.

Please note that we currently run background checks as part of our recruitment process pending a successful interview.

Interested in this opportunity? We would love to tell you more. Stay connected with us and apply.

The Company is committed to diversity and equality of opportunity for all and is opposed to any form of less favourable treatment or harassment on the grounds of race, religion or belief, sex, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment or disability

This position is based in Dunton, and it is expected the successful candidate will be able to attend the Dunton Campus for fixed 4 days a week and remain flexible on the days they are required to attend the office according to business requirements.

As part of our pre-employment checks process, successful candidates will be required to undergo a criminal record check. This will be conducted in line with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and applied only to unspent convictions.

Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Dublin or Letterkenny office and telecommuting from a home-based office in a hybrid work model.

What you will do:

Project Leadership & Execution

Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex projects from initiation through implementation
Define project scope, milestones, success metrics, governance structures, and execution strategies
Develop and maintain integrated project plans that align teams around shared objectives and timelines
Manage cross-functional dependencies and ensure coordinated execution across multiple workstreams
Monitor progress, remove roadblocks, and drive accountability for delivery commitments

Stakeholder Management & Influence

Build solid partnerships across business, technology, operations, and supporting functions
Facilitate alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities and perspectives
Drive decision-making by presenting options, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations
Resolve conflicts and navigate ambiguity to maintain project momentum

Risk Management & Problem Solving

Anticipate risks, challenges, and execution gaps before they impact delivery
Develop mitigation strategies and proactively adjust plans to address changing business needs
Escalate critical issues appropriately while recommending actionable solutions

Executive Communication & Reporting

Prepare concise, executive-ready communications, status reports, and presentations
Translate complex project activities into clear business outcomes, risks, and decisions
Provide leadership with transparency into progress, dependencies, and trade-offs

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve project delivery processes, governance, and team effectiveness
Implement best practices that increase efficiency, predictability, and execution excellence
Contribute to the maturation of project management capabilities across the organization

You will be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, as well as providing development for other roles you may be interested in.

What you will bring:

Proven extensive experience in project or program management, leading complex cross-functional initiatives
Proven experience driving projects from strategy through implementation and delivery
Demonstrated proficiency in project planning, risk management, and executive reporting
Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and dependencies simultaneously
Demonstrated solid communication, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills
Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and digital automation tools to enhance project execution, streamline processes, and improve business outcomes

Other useful skills & qualifications:

PMP, Agile, Scrum, or related project management certification
Proven experience in Payment Integrity, claims, or other payer operations
Proven experience leading initiatives within large, matrixed organizations
Proven experience supporting operational transformation, process improvement, or strategic initiatives
Proven experience leveraging AI to consolidate information and generate executive-ready reporting

Please note you must currently be eligible to work and remain indefinitely without any restrictions in the country to which you are making an application. Proof will be required to support your application.

Job Description & Summary

We are seeking an experienced senior project leader (Associate Director / Director level) to join our Consulting practice, with a focus on the transport sector. The role offers the opportunity to lead multidisciplinary teams in the delivery of major transport and infrastructure programmes, providing strategic advisory, programme oversight and assurance services that support successful investment and delivery outcomes.

We are particularly interested in candidates with extensive experience advising on and leading major transport and infrastructure programmes. The successful candidate will play a key role in helping clients establish effective governance, manage programme risks and dependencies and deliver complex capital investments in line with strategic, financial and operational objectives.

Embrace the possibility to apply – at Grant Thornton we are constantly upskilling our staff. If you do not meet all of the listed requirements, please do not be discouraged from applying. We value a growth-oriented mindset and are dedicated to supporting you in reaching your full potential.

Roles & Responsibilities

Collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team to successfully deliver and manage projects across a range of key transport sector initiatives, including:

Project Management Delivery

Leading and advising on major transport and infrastructure programmes, supporting client organisations and senior leadership teams to strengthen programme governance, assurance and delivery performance across major capital investments.

Defining and driving projects across all stages of the project life cycle, from initiation to delivery, implementation and benefits realisation.

Establishing and overseeing programme-wide governance, monitoring and assurance frameworks while managing complex interfaces, interdependencies and multi-contract delivery arrangements across large-scale infrastructure programmes.

Leading and mentoring multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaboration across client organisations, delivery partners, contractors, regulators and other key stakeholders.

Developing and maintaining robust integrated assurance strategies encompassing governance, risk, cost, schedule, design, change control, benefits realisation and programme performance.

Leading the assessment of procurement and delivery models, supporting clients in identifying appropriate approaches for the successful delivery of complex infrastructure and capital investment programmes.

Producing executive, board-level and stakeholder reporting, translating complex programme information into clear, evidence-based insights to support decision-making.

Embedding proactive risk management, programme controls and governance practices that support successful programme delivery and long-term investment outcomes.

Business Development

Building and maintaining trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across the transport and infrastructure sector, positioning Grant Thornton as a strategic advisor and partner of choice.

Leading client engagement activities, facilitating discussions, workshops and strategic planning sessions to identify client priorities, shape solutions and develop opportunities for future collaboration.

Engaging senior executives, sponsoring organisations, government bodies, regulators, delivery agencies and industry stakeholders to support successful programme outcomes and sustainable client relationships.

Developing and expanding key client accounts across the across the transport and infrastructure sector, identifying opportunities to support clients in the delivery, oversight, governance and assurance of major capital investment programmes.

Leading and directing business development initiatives, including the preparation of proposals and tenders for new transport and infrastructure sector opportunities.

Collaborating with colleagues across Advisory and the wider firm to develop integrated solutions that address programme, infrastructure and investment challenges across the transport sector.

Skills and Experience

Education and Certifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or a related field; Master’s degree or relevant professional certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, APM) strongly preferred.

Demonstrated experience working within large-scale capital investment and infrastructure delivery environments, including knowledge of programme governance, assurance frameworks and stage-gated approval processes.

8+ years' experience for Associate Director level, or 10+ years' experience for Director level, leading major transport and infrastructure programmes, with demonstrable expertise in programme governance, oversight, assurance, controls and the management of complex, multi-stakeholder delivery environments.

Skills and Competencies

Strong project and programme management experience leading and managing large multi-disciplinary teams comprised of clients, consultants, contractors and third-party delivery partners.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale transport and infrastructure programmes, including the establishment and operation of programme governance, oversight, monitoring, assurance and programme controls frameworks.
Extensive experience working across the transport and infrastructure sector, with a strong understanding of the governance, regulatory, funding and delivery landscape associated with major capital investment programmes.
Proven ability to direct and deliver complex, multi-stakeholder programmes across the full project lifecycle, from strategic planning and business case development through to implementation, assurance and benefits realisation.
Experience developing and implementing programme management approaches, including programme controls, risk management, change control, performance monitoring and continuous improvement frameworks.
Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior executives, programme sponsors and strategic stakeholders, shaping programme strategy while supporting successful delivery outcomes.
Strong organisational and multi-tasking abilities, with experience managing multiple priorities and delivering in complex, high-profile and fast-paced environments.
Significant experience in originating, leading and closing business development opportunities, including major transport and infrastructure sector tenders, frameworks and complex multi-stakeholder bids.
Expertise in senior stakeholder engagement, including government departments, transport authorities, infrastructure owners, regulators, delivery agencies and executive leadership teams.
An ability to balance big-picture thinking with acute attention to detail, translating long-term objectives into practical and deliverable solutions.
A strong interest in the future of transport and infrastructure, with an understanding of the opportunities and challenges associated with major capital investment, infrastructure delivery and programme assurance.
Experience developing and growing client accounts within the within the transport and infrastructure sector, with an established professional network and a strong understanding of market trends, client priorities and emerging investment opportunities.
A creative, problem-solving mindset and initiative-driven approach.

Location: London

Curious about what’s next?

About This Role

OpenFX is hiring its first Product Operations Manager. You will work directly with the Head of Product Operations to refine and enhance the Product Operating System across a small, dense product team building the cross-border financial infrastructure of the next decade.

This is a high-leverage seat. You will be empowered to contribute across product craft, launch motion, AI-augmented workflows, and the insights program that connects the product team to the rest of the business. You will use AI not as something you teach in a workshop but as the multiplier for your own work, and you will help every PM around you do the same. The work is real and the surface area is wide.

We are also being deliberate about who this role attracts. We treat it as an incubator for ambitious talent. The right person here in eighteen to twenty-four months has working visibility across product, engineering, GTM, and operations at a scaling fintech, and the experience to move into a senior PM, product leadership, builder, or founder role next. If you want to learn how a scaling product organization gets built and operate at the seams while you do, this is a seat for that.

About OpenFX

OpenFX is the cross-border financial infrastructure platform built on stablecoins. We move more than $50B annualized in volume for fintech clients across five continents, with a multi-product surface across FX, banking, payments, and yield. We have shipped a working FX engine and are scaling toward the next order of magnitude on volume, take rate, and currency coverage.

We operate as a small, dense team. Eight Product Managers, distributed across the US, Bangalore, and London, owning the FX, Banking, Payments, Growth, and Earn pillars. The product organization sits inside a company moving fast enough that the operating system around it is the leverage.

Where you will have impact

Four contribution areas. You will be empowered to drive these forward and we expect to flex the specific mix based on what you are strongest at. If you are a systems thinker with ambition and ideally a fintech background, we will shape the role to make you most effective.



- Product craft and standards enablement. Help raise the bar on how PMs work: discovery, hypothesis formation, written craft, trade-off thinking. Enhance the tooling that makes craft scalable, including PRD templates, mini-briefs, the AI-driven PRD review pipeline, and the playbooks underneath.
- Launch operations and Cross functional partnership. Support Product Managers through Go-Live. Own the cross-functional interface to GTM, Customer Success, and Operations on the launch motion: pre-launch readiness, the post-launch Customer.io operational stack, lifecycle and adoption campaigns, launch retros. PMs own their launches; you make the launch motion smoother and more repeatable, and you close the loop on whether what shipped actually got adopted.
- Insights and data evangelism. Help the product team listen better. Pull qualitative signal from the CS product channel, support tickets, client calls, and JTBD research into a usable layer for PMs. Connect that signal to competitive and regulatory intelligence in collaboration with the Founders Office. Champion Heap as the product analytics platform: instrumentation, dashboards, Product Health Metrics like adoption, engagement, and time-to-value. You are the layer between raw signal and PRD-ready evidence.
- AI workflows and product team leverage. Hands-on with the AI tooling stack: Claude, Cursor, agent workflows, MCP-connected pipelines. Identify where automation and agents can change how product work gets done at OpenFX: PRD drafting and review, research synthesis, sprint reporting, roadmap intelligence, competitive aggregation, insight pipelines. Build for your own work first. Then teach every PM around you and bring the team up. Partner with the CTO's office on the internal OS we are building. This is the most material lane for compounding leverage and the one we expect the strongest candidates to be most excited about.

You will also contribute alongside the Head of Product Operations on sprint reporting, roadmap mechanics, prioritization rhythms, and operating cadence. Specific ownership inside that bucket will be shaped to where you add the most leverage, with the data-driven and GTM-facing rhythms being natural starting points.

What Success Looks Like

At thirty days. You have built a real read on how the team works, where the friction is, and where the leverage is. You are in standing rhythm with each PM. You are hands-on with the AI tooling stack and have shipped one workflow that materially compresses something the team does manually today.

At ninety days. You have driven measurable improvement in at least one of the four contribution areas: PRD review quality, launch readiness, insight access for PMs, or AI-augmented PM workflow adoption. You are visibly trusted by the PMs and by GTM as a partner, not as a coordinator. You have a point of view on the next nine months and have started building toward it.

At twelve months. Product Operations at OpenFX runs at a meaningfully higher bar than the day you joined. PMs are more leveraged, launches are tighter, insight access is faster, and AI-augmented workflows are the default. You have grown into more scope than you started with and are visibly ready for the next thing, whatever that turns out to be. The function has earned the case for a second seat.

You probably have

Five to eight years in Product Operations, Strategy and Operations, or a hybrid senior PM role at a scaled fintech or B2B SaaS. You have helped a product organization raise its standards bar before.

You are AI-pilled and hands-on with AI tools as a productivity multiplier for your own work. You have built agent-driven workflows in a prior role and treat AI as a workflow lever, not a topic for a slide.

Hands-on experience with Heap or a comparable product analytics platform, plus Linear, Notion, and Customer.io. SQL enough to validate your own numbers. Either run a Voice of Customer program operationally or partnered closely with an Insights or Research lead.

You handle ambiguity well, work hard in the way builders and senior operators recognize in each other, and have the political range to operate as a peer of senior PMs and Execs without being one of them.

Bonus Experience

Direct experience in cross-border payments, FX, stablecoins, or B2B fintech infrastructure is a meaningful plus, not a requirement. We can teach the domain. We cannot teach the operational craft or the systems thinking.

Comfortable in a globally distributed, asynchronous-by-default operating model. Communication standards matter.

Prior experience as a founding Product Ops hire at another company, or as the first IC hire scaling a Product Operations function under a Head of Product Ops.

Required

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Preferred

- Exposure to AI-enabled commerce, agentic checkout, delegated payment / authentication patterns, API conformance testing, risk controls and compliance frameworks for secure agent-led transaction experiences. 

About The Team

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Murphy AI deploys voice AI agents that help banks collect debt. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication. Our advanced automation streamlines the process of collecting overdue invoices for banks and other industries, providing a seamless and effective solution.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and sms to maximize results while preserving trust. By combining advanced artificial intelligence with powerful automation, we’re setting a new standard for how businesses recover payments.

As a fast-growing startup that has already made an impact within less than a year in the market, we are building a talented team to scale our operations and drive our vision forward 🌟

About The Role

We're looking for a Product Operations Manager to scale Murphy. We need someone to deploy into new territory, impose order on chaos, and stand up the operation — then do it again in the next market. You'll own the expansion playbook, partners and vendors, product quality and enable x1,000 growth of the company that proved its product-market-fit. This is a founder's right hand on execution and operations, with outsized leverage over where the company goes.

Murphy builds AI voice agents that collect overdue debt for banks: more recovered, faster, cheaper, fully compliant, and respectful to the debtor. We're live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We've proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks — now we're taking it into every market and every adjacent business, and we need someone to own that expansion end to end.

What you'll do



- Productise expansion. Turn a new country from a bespoke project into a repeatable playbook: localised voice, policies, compliance per market, so we go live in weeks, not quarters.
- Be the operating system of the product org. Own the planning cadence, the metrics and the prioritisation across bets, so a small team makes big, fast, well-sequenced calls.
- Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the roots of complex problems, understand all the nuances and design solutions that solve the root cause elegantly.

Who you are



- A builder and an operator. You've converted uncertainty and chaos into a well-oiled execution machine — a process, a team, or a function — whether as a founder, an operations lead, a PM, or a military officer who's stood up and led an operation under pressure.
- You own outcomes, and you never settle. You hold people accountable and demand a high execution excellence bar under speed.
- You have a STEM degree, and you were top of your class. You're technical, rigorous with numbers, and have a strong philosophy of a champion.
- AI-native, ruthless on quality. You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default — and you know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously.
- You don't need a collections or fintech background. We'd rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can't ship — you'll pick up regulation, unit economics and a new market cold, fast.

🤝 What we offer

💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark.

📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential.

🧩 Real Ownership - Murphy's strategy is yours to drive.

🙌 Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact.

🗣️ The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it.

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office, and 2 days of remote work.

📚 Our Process

1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You

A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive

You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case

A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ Call with the Founders

Our founders meet every team member and it’s a great opportunity for you to learn about the company and its direction.

👉 To learn more about how we hire and what to expect at every step, feel free to explore our Hiring Guide!

👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing Reliability & Operations Engineering 👋

Trainline is a fast-growing tech company powering world-class digital journeys for millions of customers. Our platform runs primarily on AWS, built on cloud-native architecture, modern CI/CD pipelines, and strong DevOps and SRE practices.

The Reliability & Operations Engineering team (ReliabilityOps) brings together SRE, Incident Management, and Database Reliability to keep our platform observable, reliable, scalable, and resilient. We partner closely with product engineering teams to enable safe delivery, respond to incidents, and continuously strengthen system reliability.

We’re looking for a mid-level Site Reliability Engineer to help drive this forward. You’ll bring solid production experience, a growth mindset, and a willingness to challenge and be challenged — contributing to platform reliability while developing broader technical ownership with support from senior engineers.



As an SRE at Trainline, you'll be working on...🚄

 - Developing an understanding of system architecture, dependencies, and failure modes across the Trainline platform

 - Participating in production incident response, supporting investigation, mitigation, communication, and coordinated service restoration

 - Contributing to post-incident reviews and follow-up actions to improve reliability, scalability, and resilience

 - Taking part in the SRE on-call rotation

 - Designing, building, and maintaining observability using metrics, logs, events, and traces to support effective detection and diagnosis

 - Improving monitoring and alerting by aligning signals to business and customer impact, reducing noise and improving mean time to detection (MTTD)

At Monetization Product Operations (MPO) our goal is to help businesses have seamless experiences with our advertising solutions, by designing and scaling support processes to resolve technical issues within our product. The role covers ticket investigation, customer feedback analysis, product support enablement, knowledge base development(runbook/SOP), and dashboard maintenance. It is suitable for candidates with 2-5 years of experience in customer support, technical support, product operations, or a related support function, especially if they have exposure to advertising products or campaign performance analysis.

- Investigate technical and product issues raised by internal stakeholders and advertisers through ticketing systems, with a focus on campaign delivery and performance symptoms.
- Support the launch and adoption of new advertising products and features by preparing support resources, troubleshooting guides, and enablement materials.
- Contribute to ticket quality review, issue categorization, knowledge management, and support process improvement across regional and global teams.

In this Technical Principal Program Manager role you will be an integral driver for the Windows Fundamentals Compatibility team’s charter. Our job is to ensure that millions of Windows applications and devices “just work.” This sounds simple, but it’s not an easy charter considering that Windows ships feature changes and security updates monthly to billions of devices. Our job as Windows Compatibility becomes more complex as we drive quality and consistency with app and device behavior alongside changes for our retail and commercial customers.

Compatibility is a deep and broad space that offers many opportunities to learn about the complexity of the OS and how applications interact with it. We are responsible for inbox functionality to mitigate issues, we support services to keep in-market Windows devices healthy, and we play an integral role in shipping each new Windows update to the ecosystem. Across all these areas, we invest and deploy AI effectively to meet our goals. This role requires strategic leadership within the Compatibility team, as well as across the organization.

At the end of the day, you will be ensuring that we’re able to ship the full portfolio of Microsoft operating systems at the highest quality and enable our ecosystem of applications and devices to work seamlessly on this OS.

The role will also involve monitoring the effectiveness of governance arrangements, identifying opportunities for improvement, and supporting the implementation of enhanced governance processes, controls, and reporting mechanisms. Acting as a key point of contact for governance activities, the successful candidate will manage the Change Control process across the CIO function and maintain the Help Hub Governance pages, driving continuous improvements where opportunities are identified.

In addition, the successful candidate will coordinate monthly reporting to the Executive and EirGrid plc Board, working closely with the Strategy Office and internal stakeholders to ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and of a high standard. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills will be essential to build effective relationships across the organisation and support the successful delivery of governance and reporting activities.

Candidate Profile
We are seeking a motivated, organised, and detail-oriented professional who can demonstrate:
Experience supporting PMO, governance, or project delivery functions.
Strong governance and meeting management skills, including the preparation of agendas, minutes, decision logs, and action trackers.
Experience coordinating reporting activities for senior management or board-level forums.
The ability to provide governance advice and constructive challenge to stakeholders.
Strong organisational skills with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Demonstrated experience engaging with senior stakeholders and influencing outcomes across complex organisational structures.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
A proactive approach to process improvement and the implementation of governance best practices.

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to the successful delivery of strategic initiatives while supporting robust governance, effective decision-making, and continuous improvement across the organisation.

The Team

The Infrastructure office leads the development and delivery of the power system, onshore and interconnection investment programmes in collaboration with partners, customers and communities.
The Onshore Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for undertaking three key roles within Infrastructure; Regulation and Compliance Reporting and Auditing, Business Operations and Governance, and Business Intelligence. The team is responsible for setting the governance policies and standards to be used for onshore business readiness and large scale onshore transmission infrastructure and regulatory auditing and monitoring of OpEx and CapEx delivery.

The team also develops reports on schedule and financial information and delivery of outcomes and benefits aligned to strategic objectives across the development and readiness of the onshore transmission infrastructure to key stakeholders such as DECC and the CRU.

About you
Successful candidates will have:
Qualification to degree level or equivalent qualification, with at least 8 years relevant post qualification experience.
Strong interpersonal, influencing and communication skills.
Ability to develop a deep understanding of EirGrid governance methodology and approach
Excellent time management skills and proven ability to work independently.
Working knowledge of relevant software packages – Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, etc.
Ability to work collaboratively and transparently with others across the business and externally to deliver outcomes in accordance with strategic objectives.

11th September 2026

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

We create the journey search functionality that millions of our customers use on a daily basis, the eCommerce platform that provides a secure and seamless experience and we connect Trainline to over 270 travel operating companies, across 45 countries in Europe and the rest of the world. Each team has a targeted domain focus, ranging between journey search, fares calculation, bookings, fulfilment, payments, refunds, carriers’ integrations, real-time timetable information, journey disruptions and much more. 

 


AS A MID LEVEL .NET ENGINEER AT TRAINLINE YOU WILL...🚄

 - Deliver new functionality or features, using the most appropriate tools & techniques

 - Ensure quality is at the heart of everything you and your team do

 - Continuously improve the code base

 - Keep our customer as the number one priority  

 - Actively identify blockers, boulders, time sinks and waste, and actively attempt to remove them

 - Make significant contribution to technical decisions

 - Act as a coach and mentor to others in the team

 - Take full ownership of the development lifecycle from code to production, including deployment and monitoring

 


OUR TECH STACK 🔑

 - Languages & Frameworks: C# (.NET 6–10)

 - Databases: DynamoDB, PostgreSQL

 - Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS Cloud, Docker, Terraform

 - CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub Actions

 - Monitoring & Logging: New Relic, ELK Stack

 


WE'D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU...🔍

 - Have hands on experience with C# .NET and the latest features 

 - Love using Agile development practices

 - Have hands on experience working on software development of high-volume transactional applications

 - Have experience in asynchronous service/processing

 - Test your solutions effectively

 - Enjoy mentoring less experienced engineers

 - Have experience with CI/CD

 - Thrive in a diverse, open and collaborative environment

 - Have great communication skills

 - Are proactive, focused, supportive, honest and a team player

 - Have a passion to learn new skills



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

JD.com (NASDAQ: JD and HKEX: 9618), also known as JINGDONG, has evolved from a pioneering e-commerce platform into a leading technology and service provider with supply chain at its core. Renowned for its supply chain innovation and excellence, the company has expanded into sectors including retail, technology, logistics, healthcare, and more, aiming to transform traditional business models with cutting-edge digital solutions. Know more about us: https://corporate.jd.com/


JD.com is seeking an experienced Technical Product Operations Manager to join our growing technical team at Joybuy (https://www.joybuy.com/). Joybuy is JD.com’s European full-category online retail brand designed to bring customers a faster, more convenient, and cost-effective shopping experience. Offering same-day and next-day delivery across the UK, Joybuy combines speed, reliability, and affordability to meet the needs of modern shoppers. In this role, you will partner with product development teams to translate business requirements and user insights into actionable product roadmaps, ensuring timely execution. By establishing data-driven metrics to monitor performance, optimising features, and leveraging both internal and external resources to design marketing strategies, you will drive user acquisition and product-market reach, ultimately achieving business goals through superior user experience and market competitiveness.


Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end product lifecycle by aligning business strategies, user needs, and market trends. Partner with product development teams to translate business requirements and user insights into actionable product roadmaps, ensuring timely execution.
- Dive into business scenarios to collect and analyse user needs and pain points. Collaborate with product and R&D teams to develop optimisation or iteration plans. Document requirements, clarify product functions and goals, and ensure solutions meet business needs and user expectations.
- Establish data-driven metrics to monitor product performance, conduct analysis, and drive continuous feature optimisation to enhance service delivery.
- Leverage both internal and external resources to design and execute marketing and go-to-market strategies that drive user acquisition and expand product-market reach across European markets.
- Drive product localisation strategy, from translation quality and cultural adaptation to region-specific feature prioritisation and compliance requirements.
- Work closely with product management, engineering, design, marketing, merchant operations, and customer service teams across London and Beijing to ensure alignment and execution excellence.
- Work onsite in London, Dusseldorf, or Rotterdam.


Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 3+ years of experience in product operations, program management, or product management in e-commerce, marketplace, or consumer internet.
- Proven experience working in or with European markets, with a strong understanding of local consumer behaviour and market dynamics.
- Data-savvy, comfortable with SQL, Excel, data visualisation tools, and making data-backed recommendations.
- Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment.
- Fluent in English (native or professional proficiency).


Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in cross-border e-commerce or global marketplace platforms.
- Familiarity with product management frameworks (user stories, PRDs, A/B testing, release management).
- Experience working in a matrix organisation with distributed teams across time zones.
- Multilingual (French, German, Dutch, or other European language) is a plus.
- Experience with localisation tools (e.g. Lokalise, Crowdin) and content management systems.
- Chinese language ability is a strong plus for cross-team collaboration with Beijing HQ.


What We Offer:

- A dynamic and challenging work environment in a leading global e-commerce company with a fast-growing international business.
- The opportunity to work with a diverse international team spanning London and Beijing, making a significant impact on JD.com's global AI strategy.
- Competitive salary and benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and performance bonuses.
- Exposure to massive-scale data, complex cross-border e-commerce challenges, and real-world AI problems that impact millions of users.


JD.com is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Ireland: €92000 - €94000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .



- Coordinate with Project Teams and Supplier to maintain on-time equipment delivery by expediting schedules, mitigating risks, and tracking internal project-related bugs for timely resolution.
- Manage and maintain Stage-Gate Deliverables, project-level change management oversight, and overall status reporting and escalations to all project and program-level stakeholders.
- Monitor execution Key Performance Indicator (KPIs) against committed Service Level Agreement (SLAs) to track performance and deliverable standards.

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced Delivery Practice Manager (DPM) to join our ProServe Shared Delivery Team (SDT) at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll manage a team of ProServe Delivery Consultants while supporting AWS enterprise customers through transformative projects. You'll leverage your IT and/or Management Consulting background to serve as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal AWS teams.

As a DPM you will be responsible for building and managing a team of Delivery Consultants and or Engagement Managers working with customers and partners to architect and implement innovative solutions. You’ll routinely engage with Director, C-level executives, and governing boards, whilst being responsible for opportunity capture and driving engagement delivery. You’ll work closely with partner teams; drive business development initiatives through thought leadership; provide portfolio guidance and oversight; and meet and exceed customer satisfaction targets. As a DPM you are primarily focused directly or through their teams, on understanding and defining business outcomes for customers by building trust, identifying applicable AWS Professional Services offerings, and creating proposals and SOW’s.

Your experience gained leading teams within the technology sector, will equip you with the ability to optimize team performance through implementing tailored people development plans, ensuring your teams are aligned to customer needs, and have the skills and capacity to address customer outcomes. Possessing the ability to translate technical concepts into business value for customers and then talk in technical depth with teams, you will cultivate strong customer, Amazon Global Sales (AGS), and ProServe team relationships which enables exceptional business performance. DPMs success is primarily measured by consistently delivering customer engagements by supporting sales through scoping technical requirements for an engagement, delivering engagements on time, within budget, and exceeding customer expectations. They will hold the Practice total utilization goal and be responsible for optimizing team performance.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

About GreyScout


GreyScout provides an intuitive Online Brand Protection SaaS platform to enable brands and intellectual property owners to detect, verify and enforce against infringing content online. As a company, we are laser-focused on our mission to democratise intellectual property protection.


Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, we're an innovative, fast-growing technology company with all the opportunity for impact and career growth that comes with the territory.


We believe in hiring great people, and we prioritise our core values of problem-solving, learning, innovation, appreciation and team mentality in the people we hire. Our aim is to ensure everyone has the best possible experience of work, every day.


Our constant focus on innovation has brought recognition from publications including the Irish Times and Silicon Republic, as well as backing from programs such as MassChallenge Boston and Ireland’s national start-up accelerator at the NDRC.


Job Summary


This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career to jump into the heart of a fast-paced start-up and make a real impact from day one. You’ll help keep our operations running smoothly by managing updates in internal tools, coordinating tasks across teams and partners, and keeping everyone aligned with clear, timely communication.


You’ll also dive into problem-solving, tackling everyday operational challenges, supporting key administrative work, and helping us level up how we operate through better processes, documentation, and simple automations. This role is perfect for someone hungry to learn, eager to take ownership, and excited to help shape how a growing start-up works behind the scenes.


Key Responsibilities

- Perform tasks in internal systems such as updating and quality-checking data in our operational tools (internal platform, Stripe, Zapier, Jira, etc.).
- Coordinate our network of agents: assign tasks, chase missing info, ensure they follow SOPs, onboard new agents, maintain the agent database, and keep the agent knowledge base up to date.
- Provide friendly and timely status updates to customers, including joining occasional customer calls when needed.
- Investigate and troubleshoot operational issues such as delivery problems, failed payments, or disputed purchases; document incidents clearly and escalate when necessary.
- Assist with customer invoice reconciliation and other supporting administrative tasks.
- Maintain and improve process flows, including spreadsheets, simple automations, “how-to” articles, FAQs, and other relevant operational materials.
- Contribute ideas for workflow improvements or tool upgrades, and support testing and documentation before roll-out.


Must-Have Skills & Experience

- Degree or 1+ year of hands-on experience in Business, Finance, Operations, Logistics, or a related field Logistics, or a related field.
- Strong data mindset: confident using spreadsheets (lookups, pivots, filters) and excited to learn low-code tools like Zapier.
- Analytical problem-solver: able to break down issues, follow them across multiple systems, and propose practical solutions.
- Clear, confident communicator with strong written English and the ability to join customer calls when needed.
- High attention to detail: you catch mismatches, missing info, and small errors before they cause problems.
- Positive & empathetic.
- Adaptable self-starter who learns new tools quickly and stays organized while juggling multiple tasks.


Bonus Points

- Exposure to payment platforms (e.g., Stripe) or e-commerce / logistics workflows
- Basic SQL


Core Benefits and Perks

- Employee Share Options (ESOP) — share in the upside that you help us create.
- Competitive salary.
- 30 days annual leave.
- Pension benefit (specific to region)
- Give back program (pledge1percent.org).
- Educational resources and generous allowance to support development.
- Inclusive policies - maternity, paternity & parental leave.
- Top-class equipment and choice of hardware.

The Role

OVERVIEW

This role assumes responsibility for managing media sponsorship activity for multiple client
accounts. The role will also act as the main point of contact for both clients and Media Teams
surrounding the day-to-day media sponsorship management activity and supports the Head of
Media Sponsorship in fostering strong relationships with clients.

It requires the use of media planning tools, the effective management of the media sponsorship
processes (briefing, negotiating, management, reporting) and excellent attention to detail and
time management to ensure best in class delivery on behalf of the Sponsorship Practice for
clients.

It also requires strong collaboration and communication with the wider organisation across the
integral teams to ensure that delivery is to the highest standards and relevant opportunities are
brought to clients in a timely and proactive manner. A strong, collaborative working relationship
with colleagues within the practice, agency Media Teams across all levels, Investment and media
owners is a crucial element of this role. The ideal candidate will enjoy working in a fast-paced
environment with a drive to succeed and can multi-task in a deadline driven atmosphere.

Responsibilities
The role of the Sponsorship Client Director assumes the responsibility of project manager for
each media sponsorship from their assigned Media Agency/Agencies and will have the
responsibility of developing the Media Sponsorship rationale for their clients. The role will also
involve meeting and exceeding team revenue targets set in the business plan. The Sponsorship
Client Director will need to foster a strong a working relationship with our colleagues in the
Media Practices and gain a thorough understanding of their client’s key objectives. They will be
the expert in their field on which the Media Teams will rely on for recommendations, advice,
and management. This role is central to the efficient and effective running of the day to day
media sponsorship service and management. This includes the creation and tracking of
sponsorship critical paths, timely and accurate billing/spend projections, delivering relevant
sponsorship opportunities to the highest standard, presenting response to briefs, thinking
proactively and innovatively and always being on the quest to find new and exciting
opportunities for clients. The Sponsorship Client Director will work closely with Investment and
the AV Team to ensure we are offering our clients best in market value and providing insightful
reporting to both clients and Media Teams.
KPIs will include revenue targets, growing the Sponsorship Practice’s reputation internally and
externally, and the media sponsorship service scores in the annual RADAR service review.

AGENCY PERFORMANCE
• Project management of the media sponsorship process, working closely with Media Team
colleagues, Investment, Channel Planning and other integral teams to ensure Sponsorship
Practice output is of the highest standard
• Management of media sponsorship projects from start to end (dealing with client queries,
negotiating with media owners, coordinating reports, monitoring, presenting results)
• Understanding of the key business challenge for their clients and addressing these challenges
with appropriate sponsorship platforms.
• Maintaining strong relationships with media owners and having a deep understanding of their
properties.
• Analyse and understand reports. Use the data generated to provide insights and identify clear
actions to be taken
• Understand how each Practice and integral team within Core can contribute to the overall
plan
• Validate sponsorship campaign delivery and performance and create post campaign reviews
for clients
• Leading sponsorship presentations to clients and agency teams
• Coordinating media owner briefs and delivery

COMMERCIAL PERFORMANCE
• Collection of client POs and manage the internal communication of POs across teams ensuring
effective and efficient month end billing for all media sponsorship activity
• Overall responsibility for billing at the end of each month
• Manage media sponsorship budgets, forecasting and aged debt
• Ensure all billing is 100% accurate and on time for all media sponsorships

TALENT MANAGEMENT
• Commit to the internal training Core Learning programme(s) and regularly attend training for
your development
• Developing understanding of client business, their Key Business Priorities for the year and lead
in creating media sponsorship strategies to deliver against them
• Ensure close collaboration with Media Sponsorship and Media Teams to ensure that they are
enabled to actively assist your development and to ensure the consistent delivery of the highest
standard of agency output
• Ensure a strong comprehension and commitment to your career development plan in line with
your 360 appraisal, quarterly catch up’s and goals with your line manager
• Uphold the Core values in words and actions
• embracing our value of Togetherness through cross company collaboration
• Proactively build relationships within the wider company
• Contribute to a hardworking and fun team environment

Your profile

Experience
• Previous media experience with proven track record in campaign management, exceeding
KPIs. Knowledge of the digital disciplines would be beneficial.
• Media owner experience in a sales capacity is beneficial but not essential
• Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office, in particular Excel and PowerPoint
• Experience in managing and executing large scale, complex media campaigns is essential
• Experience of being the lead contact across multiple stakeholder levels
• High level of business and financial acumen
• Presentation skills

Person Specification
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Good listener - ability to understand what the client requirements are
• Well presented and confident
• Team player - be solution focused, and responsible for the development and motivation of
junior team members
• Have the ability to self-manage and work on ones own initiative
• To be energetic, innovative and creative when communicating with clients and colleagues
• Learn on a continuous basis while also sharing knowledge
• Leadership skills – take the lead role during brainstorming sessions, review new areas of
opportunity for the company, generate new ideas for clients and the organisation
• Highly organised individual that can manage multiple teams and their delivery of work
• Strategic thinker - think more strategically about the clients and their business, be able to
see where improvements can be made and implement these changes
• Understands and appreciates the benefit of processes and how it links to company success
• Take an interest in the management and implementation of new revenue streams for the
company

Why us?

Work your way – Flexible, hybrid working that gives you the freedom to do your best work while fitting around your life.
Keep growing – Invest in your development with 24/7 internal learning programme access, structured mentoring and clear opportunities to progress your career.
Work that keeps things interesting – Partner with leading brands across sport, retail, food & drink, alcohol, insurance, banking and many more, with no two days the same.
Time to switch off – Enjoy 21 days' annual leave with an additional increment with your time with us. Separate to this celebrate your birthday off, Christmas closure days and early finishes before bank holiday weekends.
A culture that supports balance – We genuinely value work–life balance and encourage you to take the time you need to perform at your best.
Support for every stage of life – From enhanced maternity and paternity leave & other family leaves, to fertility support, phased returns, we're here for life's important moments.
Your wellbeing matters – Access mental health and wellbeing support, plus paid private health insurance for you and your dependants under 18, an Employee Assistance Programme, annual wellness contributions, free flu vaccinations, wellness events, fresh fruit, subsidised massages and more.
Plan ahead with confidence – Benefit from a contributory pension, life assurance cover and access to professional financial advice.
Make an impact beyond your role – Join our Diversity & Inclusion, CSR, Green, Social or Great Place to Work committees and even earn an extra day's annual leave for your contribution.
Join an award-winning workplace – Proudly recognised as a Great Place to Work® Certified organisation, ranked 4th in the Great Place to Work® Best Large Workplaces, and awarded Gold accreditation for our commitment to creating an exceptional employee experience.
A genuinely inclusive culture – Diversity, Equity & Inclusion isn't just a policy here; it's part of who we are. Through our dedicated D&I initiatives, employee networks and inclusive policies, we strive to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered.
We know how to have fun – From summer and Christmas parties to team socials, fundraising activities, birthday celebrations and company-wide events, we make time to celebrate our people.
And that's just the start...

OUR COMMITMENTS
Our industry relies on creativity and innovation – these are skills that are not bound by gender, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, membership of the Traveller community, marital or family status, disability, age, socio-economic background, or any other attributes. Core is committed to diversity in its workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to all applicants. If you need reasonable accommodation for any reason at any part of the interview process, please contact us and let us know the nature of your request and we will do our best to help.

Salary Range

€60,000 - €72,000 DOE

About us

Core is Ireland's largest marketing communications company with over 400 people working across the key areas of marketing communications - research, data science, strategy, planning, creative development and implementation. We are now a collective of nine practices, working towards a single purpose - to expand the possibilities of what brands can achieve. At Core, we believe that change can move us forward and compel us towards new possibilities. Our wonderful people are at the centre of our success. It is essential that we keep building a high-trust working environment that supports our people and enables them to flourish. There is no magic formula for becoming a great place to work. Instead, it involves working together, through constant change, to match the personal dreams and ambitions of our people with the aspirations of the organisation.

Over the years, we have cemented our position as a great place to work, with 2026 being voted 4th Best Large Workplace in Ireland. Additionally, we are recognised as a Best Workplace for Women, and Best Workplace for Health & Wellbeing. 2026 is our best year yet, and we're excited to have you join us and our continued success.

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Product Operations (ProdOps) is a small collaborative team of specialists at Wise. The team itself is in a strong growth phase hence the need for this role. Our team has a rich mix, a broad range of experiences and subject matter experts to support your growth. ProdOps is organised into two sub-teams: Central who work across all of Product Development and Embedded who work within the tribes.

This role will be part of the Central Product Operations team so you’ll get visibility and exposure to all Product teams but also all the adjacent teams that work with us.

The focus of ProdOps is the machine (people & process) which underpins the build of our products. We have 120+ autonomous product teams, organised into 30+ squads and 6 tribes. Our product teams are cross functional and made up of some of the best engineers, product managers, analysts, designers, data scientists & researchers on the planet!

Your Mission

Reporting to the Senior Product Operations Manager, you’ll help facilitate and manage the internal operational processes and cadences of our global Product team. You’ll handle the daily operational and logistical tasks that keep our Product development running smoothly. Your role will enable and empower the Product teams to do their best work, build the best products and ultimately deliver real value for our customers.

Key Responsibilities

This role focuses on two main aspects:



- Product portfolio rhythms and rituals
- Product community & culture 

Product portfolio rhythms & rituals



- Own the logistical facets of our Company Planning Update ritual - ensuring everything goes off without a hitch from comms planning to workplace liaising and everything in between. Currently this happens 2-3 times per year. You’ll have the opportunity to be involved in the strategy and content too.
- Co-ordinate our quarterly Squad Days - from planning, execution, comms and dealing with inbound requests
- Maintain best practices with internal documentation, making sure our central depository of information is upheld and remains relevant
- Take administrative work off senior team members plates so they can focus on big-picture strategy and planning

Product community & culture



- Support all areas of event execution on our annual Product Day and be heavily involved from day one - your opinion on how PMs connect, content, event planning, structure and logistics is valuable
- Organise the logistical side of our London Product Lunch. You’ll also work alongside the Central team seniors and the sponsors on ideas, content and structure
- Someone who can collaborate cross team and help the senior manager to build up an C&C programme
- Open up your idea vault, we are all ears!

Qualifications

A bit about you:



- Operationally and logistically strong - someone process oriented who can build and refine workflows to make them more efficient and scalable
- Highly organised - you can manage your work and thoughts effectively and carry out admin tasks efficiently
- Articulate and engaging communication -you can tailor your style depending on your audience
- Excellent at maintaining strong working relationships across teams 
- Worked with a range of stakeholder types and a variety of teams
- Great with internal tooling and documentation/publishing pages
- Resilient - you welcome feedback and constantly seeks fresh ways to improve
- Adaptable - Can make make quick decisions and move with changes
- A ‘do-er’ attitude, can pull up their sleeves, leave their ego at the door and just get stuff done!
- Someone who truly cares about the value of community and culture
- Global mindset - you can think big and can adapt to different ways of working 
- Full of ideas to bring some creative flair to the team

Nice To Have



- Involvement in large scale internal company events 
- Tech or fast moving industries background
- Slack, Confluence, AI tools experience would be advantageous
- Has experience working with globally spread teams but not mandatory

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
