Technical Leadership & Team Ownership

• Acting as the technical escalation point for the team — owning complex incidents end-to-end and ensuring nothing stalls without clear direction

• Mentoring and upskilling junior and mid-level engineers: pairing on problems, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge deliberately and consistently

• Setting and maintaining quality standards for ticket management, documentation, and technical investigations across the team

• Driving team readiness — identifying skill gaps, flagging them to the Lead, and taking initiative to close them through coaching or knowledge sessions

• Leading by example in attitude, thoroughness, communication, and follow-through — shaping the team culture through daily behaviour

• Supporting the Workplace Technology Lead with operational decisions, workload balancing, and service improvements

Incident, Problem & Request Management

• Owning the full incident lifecycle for complex and high-priority issues — from triage and investigation through to resolution and post-incident review

• Conducting deep root cause analysis: reviewing logs, correlating cross-system patterns, engaging third-party vendors, and documenting findings clearly

• Ensuring the team's ticket queue is healthy — proactively monitoring dashboards, reassigning where needed, and preventing SLA breaches before they happen

• Driving problem management: identifying recurring incidents, initiating investigations, and leading permanent fix efforts rather than accepting repeat workarounds

• Owning escalation quality — ensuring issues are fully investigated, clearly documented, and appropriately packaged before being escalated to Tier 3 or vendors

Microsoft 365, Azure AD & Identity Management

• Advanced administration of Microsoft 365 services: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and the M365 Security & Compliance Centre

• Azure Active Directory: user and group lifecycle, Conditional Access policy design and troubleshooting, SSPR, MFA enforcement, and RBAC

• Leading SSO/SAML integrations for new SaaS platforms — configuring, testing, and documenting alongside the security team

• Owning access package governance and token management processes, ensuring alignment with policy and audit requirements

• Supporting licence governance: E3/E5 procurement, assignment, cost awareness, and flagging any out-of-policy requests to the appropriate stakeholder

AV/VC & Events Support

• Taking ownership of the AV/VC estate — maintaining full health of meeting room systems including display hardware, conferencing codecs, room controllers, and peripherals

• Proactive health monitoring using remote administration tools, with performance analytics and regular firmware/software updates

• Leading in-person and remote technical delivery for internal events and Executive/all-hands presentations

• Acting as the senior point of contact for AV issues, ensuring fast resolution and minimal meeting disruption across all sites

• Documenting AV configurations and building runbooks that enable the wider team to support the estate confidently

End User Computing & Device Management

• Advanced MacOS and Windows 11 management via JAMF Pro and Microsoft Intune/Autopilot — including policy authoring, troubleshooting complex deployment failures, and estate-wide configuration management

• Overseeing the quality of on/off-boarding processes: laptop builds, IT inductions, IAM compliance, deprovisioning, and asset retrieval

• Driving IT Asset Management maturity: inventory accuracy, lifecycle planning, hardware refresh adherence, and secure disposal compliance

• Working knowledge of Android and Linux environments; able to support edge cases confidently

Security, Compliance & Governance

• Championing security standards across the team — ensuring all activity aligns with ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and internal policy

• Leading the team's contribution to audit and compliance reviews: ensuring evidence is well-organised, processes are followed, and findings are acted on

• Owning the leavers process for sensitive cases — coordinating deprovisioning, data access controls, and asset recovery in line with CISO and privacy requirements

• Supporting MFA rollout, access policy governance, and SSO governance initiatives with appropriate rigour and documentation

• Ensuring all advice given to the team is backed by security sign-off and documented reference — not informal Slack approvals

Documentation, Process & Continuous Improvement

• Owning and continuously improving the team's knowledge base — SOPs, runbooks, known error records, and onboarding guides must be accurate, accessible, and up to date

• Identifying process inefficiencies and owning their improvement: not just flagging them but designing, implementing, and embedding the fix

• Driving automation and tooling improvements — proposing and where possible implementing AI, ML, and scripting solutions that reduce toil and improve consistency

• Ensuring approvals, decisions, and audit trails live in the ticketing system — not in Slack channels

Our Tech Stack requires solid experience of 🔑

• Windows 11 and Apple ecosystem in an enterprise environment (+ working knowledge of Android & Linux)

• Mobile Device Management: JAMF Pro and Microsoft Intune — policy creation, complex troubleshooting, and deployment strategy

• Microsoft 365 administration — Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and M365 Security & Compliance Centre

• Azure Active Directory — user lifecycle, Conditional Access, SSPR, MFA, and RBAC at an administrative level

• Modern workplace solutions: Autopilot, Intune, MFA, and cloud migration strategies

• Platform integrations, SSO/SAML — configuration, fault diagnosis, and documentation

• AV/VC hardware and software: room systems, conferencing platforms, and peripheral management

• Networks: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN, WAN, and wireless

• Windows Command Line / PowerShell & Apple Scripting / BASH — beyond basics; able to write and adapt scripts

• SaaS applications including Slack, Atlassian suite, and cloud printing solutions

• ITSM platforms: lifecycle ticket management, SLA reporting, and queue ownership

• Security tools, best practices, PCI-DSS, and ISO 27001

• Runbook authoring and technical documentation to a high standard



Desirable Certifications:

• Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)

• Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert or Security Administrator Associate

• Azure fundamentals

• Apple certifications for MacOS: ACSP (ACTC), JAMF 100

• CompTIA A+ or Network+

• ITIL Foundation v4 or V5

We'd love to hear from you if you... 🔍

• Take genuine ownership — you don't wait to be told, you see what needs doing and you do it

• Have the technical depth to anchor a team: complex problems don't rattle you, they motivate you

• Actively lift those around you — you share knowledge freely, coach patiently, and take pride in the team's performance, not just your own

• Communicate with clarity and confidence at all levels, from a junior engineer to an Executive stakeholder

• Conduct thorough, methodical investigations — you dig into logs, correlate patterns, and document what you find before reaching conclusions

• Have a genuine security-first mindset and understand why governance and audit trails matter

• Spot broken processes and own fixing them — not just flagging them

• Work autonomously under pressure, exercising sound judgement and knowing when to escalate

• Are happy to be onsite as needed, including for events and critical incidents

If you're a senior engineer who wants to do more than close tickets — who wants to shape a team, own a service, and leave things better than you found them — this is the role for you.

The Context

Conveo is scaling fast and has very ambitious revenue targets. Every function (Engineering, Product, Sales, CS, Marketing) is getting sharper in isolation. To keep scaling, we are building at lightning speed and the places we lose momentum now sit at the seams: the handoff from Sales to CS, the expansion motion in our top accounts, the onboarding ramp, the feedback loop from customers back into Product.

GTM Operations is the team that walks into those seams, diagnoses where they leak, designs the new way of working, proves it cross-functionally, and hands it off as a playbook the functional team can run without us.

Net Revenue Retention and Expansion ARR are our scoreboard. You won't own the number. You will use it as the guiding light for every leak you chase and every playbook you ship.

This role is the operator behind the motion. The Strategy & Ops Lead frames the bet and owns the end-to-end arc. You are the person who makes it actually land: you run the diagnostic, you own a workstream inside the project, you build the playbook, you keep momentum every week. If you do this well for 12 to 18 months, you run your own motion end to end.

Your Mission



-  Run the diagnostic with rigor

The first 30 days of every motion is diagnostic. Your job is to walk into a function, find where the effort is not converting to outcome, and ground the diagnosis in evidence.



- Pull the data. Build the cohort, the funnel, the churn view, the cycle-time chart, whatever shows where the motion is leaking. 
- Shadow the calls, sit in the rituals, read the tickets, join the project. You know how the motion actually runs, not just how it's described on paper. 
- Talk to the operators. Interview the CSMs, AEs, onboarding leads, support team. Synthesize what you hear into patterns, not anecdotes. 
- Size the leak in revenue or time terms. Make it easy for the exec team to rank the fix against the next one. 
-  Own a workstream inside strategic cross-functional projects and own smaller projects in full

When the Lead ships a cross-functional project, you are the single accountable owner of a piece of it. You drive momentum on that piece every week, no one has to chase you. You also manage smaller projects end to end.



- Run the workstream end to end: plan, cadence, artefacts, decisions, escalations. 
- Keep the cross-functional stakeholders aligned. Send the weekly update before anyone asks for it. Make the status obvious. 
- Ship a v1 in days or weeks, not quarters. Measure it against the KPIs. Iterate until the numbers move. 
- When something slips, you surface it early with the fix already drafted. Never let a blocker sit quietly. 
-  Turn the motion into a playbook

A motion that only works because the Strategy & Ops team is running it is not a system. You are the person who turns "this worked" into "this runs on rails."



- Document the playbook: the workflow, the triggers, the decisions, the escalation paths, the scripts. Make it so clear a new recruit can run it on day one. 
- Build the templates, dashboards, and trackers the functional team will use after the handover. 
- Automate the repetitive parts. Default to the AI or workflow tool that removes the work, not a new hire. 
- Train the functional team to own it. Stay on call for 4 to 6 weeks post-handover. If the team can't take it over yet, you continue to own it. 

What We're Looking For

Must-haves



- 1 to 3 years at a top strategy consulting firm (MBB, Big 4 Strategy, LEK, OC&C, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman) with evidence of owning a workstream end to end. Or: 2+ years in a high-velocity operator seat (BizOps / RevOps analyst, Chief of Staff org, early-stage startup generalist) building things that stuck. 
- Sharp analytical chops. You can pull data, build a model, and pressure-test an assumption without waiting for a data request queue. 
- Crisp written communication. Your docs, memos, and updates make decisions faster, not slower. 
- Proven ability to own something end to end, from scope to ship, without hand-holding. 
- Evidence of cross-functional collaboration. You have worked with people outside your function and kept them aligned without formal authority. 
- AI-native. You default to building with AI, not asking for more headcount. 
- Willing to be based in Antwerp HQ or the UK, with regular travel to HQ. 

Mindset



- High agency, low ego. You see what needs to happen and you make it happen. You do not care who gets credit. 
- Learner. You are hungry, coachable, and you compound quickly. You want to be unrecognisably better in 12 months. 
- Momentum is a feature. You ship a rough v1 this week rather than a perfect v3 next quarter. 
- Quality bar. When you hand something over, it is polished, documented, and the team is trained. 
- Curious and rigorous. You love going deep. You don't stop at the first answer. 

Nice to have



- Pre-MBA or fresh post-MBA from a top school. 
- Exposure to B2B SaaS, AI, or enterprise software as an analyst or operator. 
- Fluency with data and automation tooling: SQL, Hex, Looker, Zapier / n8n, AI workflow builders. 
- Experience with consumer insights, market research, or the CMO buyer

Why Join Conveo?

At Conveo, you'll join a team that genuinely enjoys working, and spending time, together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That's why we run quarterly team offsites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun.



- Own a high-impact role at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company in full scaling mode
- Work across every function in the business: Engineering, Product, CS, Sales, Marketing. Rare exposure at this seniority
- Work with world-class enterprise clients (Unilever, Google, P&G, Orange, and more)
- Direct access to the Chief of Staff, Strategy & Ops Lead, VP of sales, VP of Client Growth and the founders on the motions that matter most
- Hybrid working model with offices in Antwerp, London, and New York. Base yourself at HQ or in the UK with frequent time in Antwerp
- Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside
- A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition

5b1c366fde15cfe4.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Trust is central to Stripe’s mission to grow the GDP of the internet and the Risk team advances that mission by building products and infrastructure that Stripe businesses, Stripe product teams, and Stripe’s network of regulators and financial partners rely on. From helping businesses onboard to Stripe to managing regulatory compliance at scale, Risk is at the center of what makes Stripe run. The Technical Program Manager team is responsible for delivering the cross-Stripe programs that help businesses grow on Stripe, enable products to launch safely at scale, and Stripe to maintain its position as the most trusted network in the financial ecosystem.

What you’ll do

You will lead a team of TPMs and PGMs to deliver on Stripe’s most complex, cross-cutting, and critical programs. As a manager, you will support your team in leading programs that advance Stripe and Risk’s mission. You’ll hire, coach, and grow a team of excellent TPMs that support Stripe’s growing needs and the individuals’ careers. You will also act as a TPM yourself on the most complex initiatives that uniquely need your hands-on leadership.

Responsibilities



- Build, lead and manage high-performing teams, managers, and individuals, across multiple locations, including providing performance reviews, continual feedback, and career growth.
- Define and deliver on long-term vision and multi-year strategy for company-wide programs collaborating with product management and engineering leadership/executives.
- Define success criteria, delivery plans, track risks, and ensure successful execution of Risk’s most complex programs.
- Make substantial improvements to how the teams you work with communicate and operate to significantly increase the productivity and efficiency of the teams.


Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements



- 5+ years of management experience of varying seniority, including managing managers
- 8+ years of software engineering, systems engineering or technical product/program management experience
- Extensive experience in finding and growing talent through coaching, mentoring, and career development conversations
- Experience driving technical programs from ideation to delivery at scale and leading teams of Technical Program Managers who have done the same
- Experience operating autonomously and leading across multiple teams, with stakeholders in different disciplines across time zones
- Ability to demonstrate critical thinking and thought leadership


Preferred Qualifications



- You are comfortable working with geographically distributed teams
- You’ve managed teams that designed and operated critical infrastructure
- You are empathetic to customer needs but visionary enough to not just deliver a faster horse
- You are excited about collaborating with teammates across Stripe’s organization
- Past experience as an engineer or similar technical role


In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €149,800 - €224,800. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

5b6fb7beb9319880.description:
Why Faculty? 

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About The Team

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

About The Role

As a Delivery Manager in our Energy Transition & Environment team at Faculty, you will act as a pivotal commercial and delivery lead, driving high-stakes AI transformation for the UK’s most critical partners in this space.

You will be a key point of contact for both our external clients and internal technical teams, building deep networks of influence and solving complex challenges by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research and operational mission needs.

With an entrepreneurial spirit, you will work with multidisciplinary teams to ensure every project delivers meaningful, long-term value in a fast-evolving landscape.

What You'll Be Doing



- Owning the end-to-end delivery of our AI projects for prominent clients across the energy and utilities value chain, from initial scoping and daily driving to final implementation
- Collaborating with technical, innovation, and other key client teams
- Managing projects, driving development and ensuring a delivery approach that provides maximum value to the customer
- Forming strong, trusting relationships with customers, internal team members (e.g. data scientists, ML engineers), and technical partners to translate user research into solution requirements and operational impact
- Developing and executing compelling proposals to grow our footprint and impact across the Energy Transition sector.
- Advising clients on AI strategy and technical implementation, acting as a trusted partner in high-stakes environments (with support from a technical team)
- Mentoring your peers and taking a proactive role in building robust processes and practices within the team.

Who We're Looking For



- You possess experience in consultancy or service-based delivery, allowing you to manage complex project lifecycles and meet critical deadlines under pressure.
- You possess a broad understanding of the energy value chain, ideally with demonstrable experience working for relevant players (for example, but not limited to: utilities, suppliers, traders, policymakers/regulators)
- You take full responsibility for the successful delivery of your projects, from initial scoping to end-user adoption within regulated businesses
- You are an exceptional communicator, with outstanding skills in managing senior stakeholders and translating complex concepts for non-technical audiences.
- You are comfortable working with technical teams and have a proven track record of delivering technical projects, ideally in AI.
- You are a practical problem-solver, identifying potential risks to important missions in this space and proactively implementing solutions.
- You thrive in ambiguous settings and demonstrate a structured approach to problem-solving and delivering high-quality, high-stakes projects.

The Interview Process



- Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)
- Introduction Interview (60 minutes)
- Case Study Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some Of Our Standout Benefits



- Unlimited Annual Leave Policy
- Private healthcare and dental
- Enhanced parental leave
- Family-Friendly Flexibility & Flexible working
- Sanctus Coaching
- Hybrid Working

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

Project Manager – Hyperscale Data Centre & Fibre Infrastructure
Location: Site / Hybrid – UK, Europe & USA
Department: Service Delivery
Reporting to: Head of Service Delivery
Travel: Regular international travel required


An established provider of fibre optic, structured cabling and critical infrastructure solutions is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the delivery of large-scale Data Centre and Hyperscale infrastructure projects.
This is a senior, client-facing delivery role with responsibility for managing complex projects from initial handover and planning through to delivery, commercial close-out and client handover.
You will manage high-value fibre and connectivity projects within hyperscale and enterprise environments, working across live data centre facilities and coordinating multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors and stakeholders.
This is a hands-on Project Manager position suited to someone comfortable operating in fast-paced, mission-critical environments. You will be responsible for project performance across programme, cost, quality, risk and safety, while maintaining strong client relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
What You'll Be Doing
Project Delivery

- Lead the end-to-end delivery of large-scale Data Centre and fibre infrastructure projects.
- Manage projects from sales handover and mobilisation through to delivery, commercial close-out and client sign-off.
- Develop and manage detailed project plans, delivery strategies, resource plans and risk registers.
- Deliver large-scale fibre infrastructure supporting spine-leaf network architectures, including high-count backbone and connectivity deployments.
- Monitor project performance across programme, cost, quality, risk and client requirements.
- Coordinate multiple teams, including shift-based and 24/7 operations where required.
- Ensure all works are delivered in line with contractual obligations, SLAs and project requirements.
Client & Stakeholder Management

- Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with hyperscale, enterprise and critical infrastructure clients.
- Lead project meetings, governance reviews and service reviews.
- Provide clear and accurate updates on project progress, risks, constraints and required actions.
- Work closely with internal teams, subcontractors, suppliers and client stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
Commercial & Financial Management

- Take responsibility for project budgets, cost control and commercial performance.
- Manage forecasting, resource utilisation and project expenditure.
- Support and manage project P&L and margin performance.
- Oversee change control and ensure commercial risks and opportunities are managed effectively.
- Support accurate invoicing, revenue forecasting and commercial close-out.
Operational & Resource Management

- Lead and coordinate installation engineers, service teams, subcontractors and third-party suppliers.
- Manage resource planning across multiple project activities and locations.
- Ensure projects meet required quality, security, uptime and compliance standards.
- Drive continuous improvement across project delivery and operational performance.
- Support the management and resolution of issues within live and fast-paced delivery environments.
Risk, Safety & Compliance

- Identify and manage project risks, particularly those associated with high-density deployments, complex cable routing and live Data Centre environments.
- Ensure compliance with relevant health and safety legislation and project requirements.
- Oversee the preparation and implementation of RAMS.
- Promote a strong safety-first culture across project teams and subcontractors.
- Ensure project activities are delivered in accordance with client, regulatory and environmental requirements.
Pre-Sales & Technical Support

- Work with sales and technical teams to support project proposals and solution development.
- Provide project delivery input during pre-sales and technical workshops.
- Ensure proposed solutions are practical, scalable and commercially deliverable.
- Support technical discussions relating to fibre infrastructure, structured cabling and Data Centre connectivity.
What We're Looking For
Essential

- Significant experience as a Project Manager within Data Centres, fibre infrastructure, structured cabling or other critical infrastructure environments.
- Proven experience delivering large-scale, high-value projects for enterprise, mission-critical or hyperscale clients.
- Strong understanding of Data Centre infrastructure, including fibre, copper, structured cabling and connectivity.
- Experience managing complex project lifecycles from planning and mobilisation through to delivery and handover.
- Strong commercial experience, including budgets, forecasting, cost control and project P&L.
- Proven experience managing project teams, subcontractors and third-party suppliers.
- Strong client-facing and stakeholder management experience.
- Experience working within high-pressure, SLA-driven or mission-critical environments.
- Knowledge of project risk management, change control and project governance.
- Strong leadership, communication and decision-making skills.
- Proficiency in relevant project management tools and methodologies.
- Willingness and flexibility to travel across the UK, Europe and the USA.
- Full clean driving licence.
Desirable

- Experience delivering projects within Hyperscale Data Centre environments.
- Understanding of spine-leaf network architectures.
- Exposure to GPU, AI or high-performance computing infrastructure.
- Experience managing high-density rack deployments and complex fibre infrastructure.
- PRINCE2, Agile or equivalent project management qualifications.
- IOSH or other relevant Health & Safety qualification.
- First Aid certification.
What's on Offer

- Competitive salary and performance-based incentive scheme.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Company pension.
- Private healthcare.
- Life insurance.
- Opportunity to deliver major Data Centre and critical infrastructure projects across the UK, Europe and USA.
Summary
This is a senior, hands-on Project Manager role for someone with strong experience delivering complex Data Centre, fibre or critical infrastructure projects.
You will lead project delivery in demanding environments, manage clients and commercial performance, coordinate multidisciplinary teams and play a key role in delivering infrastructure supporting the next generation of high-density and high-performance computing environments.

5f18e849e72e67f0.description:
Company Overview

Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: IBKR) is a global financial services company headquartered in Greenwich, CT, USA, with offices in over 15 countries. We have been at the forefront of financial innovation for over four decades, known for our cutting-edge technology and client commitment.

IBKR affiliates provide global electronic brokerage services around the clock on stocks, options, futures, currencies, bonds, and funds to clients in over 200 countries and territories. We serve individual investors and institutions, including financial advisors, hedge funds and introducing brokers. Our advanced technology, competitive pricing, and global market help our clients to make the most of their investments.

Barron's has recognized Interactive Brokers as the #1 online broker for six consecutive years. Join our dynamic, multi-national team and be a part of a company that simplifies and enhances financial opportunities using state-of-the-art technology.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Product Specialist to join our Product Management team. This role will focus primarily on tax-efficient account types, with particular emphasis on Individual Savings Accounts (ISA) and Self-Invested Personal Pensions (SIPP). Reporting directly to the COO, you will be responsible for ensuring operational excellence across tax-efficient product controls, driving product enhancements to improve client experience, and identifying opportunities to foster business growth through product innovation. The role combines hands-on operational responsibilities—including control reviews, issue remediation, and management information oversight—with strategic product development activities aimed at maintaining competitive positioning in the UK retail investment market. This is an exceptional opportunity for a commercially aware professional with demonstrable ISA experience to take ownership of a critical product line within a high-growth, global financial services organization.

Key Responsibilities

Product Control & Operational Oversight



- Conduct first-line-of-defence monitoring of product controls and operational processes for ISA, SIPP, and European tax-efficient accounts (e.g., PEA, ISK, TBSZ). Perform and oversee regular control reviews to prevent, detect, and remediate issues including ineligible investments, over-contributions, and cash/in-specie transfer errors.
- Develop and maintain control frameworks to ensure ongoing compliance with HMRC ISA regulations, FCA requirements, and relevant European tax authority rules. Escalate control breaches and coordinate remediation activities with Operations, Compliance, and Technology teams.
- Monitor key performance indicators and management information related to tax-efficient account operations. Identify trends, anomalies, and areas requiring attention, producing regular reports for senior management.
- Act as the primary point of contact for complex operational issues relating to UK tax-efficient accounts, coordinating resolution across Client Services, Operations, Tax, Legal and Compliance functions.

Product Enhancement & Client Experience



- Drive continuous improvement of the client experience by identifying friction points across the client journey, including account opening, funding, transfers, trading, and withdrawals.
- Project manage product enhancement initiatives from conception through implementation and post-launch review. Develop project plans including scope, timelines, resource requirements, dependencies, and risk mitigation strategies.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams and manage stakeholder expectations across Technology, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Commercial functions to deliver product improvements on time and within budget.
- Develop and maintain product documentation including user guides, FAQs, training materials, and internal process documentation to support Client Services teams and enhance client self-service capabilities.
- Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement in product delivery processes.

Business Growth & Strategic Development



- Leverage product knowledge and market expertise to identify opportunities for business growth, including product feature enhancements, new client segment targeting, and competitive positioning improvements.
- Analyse client behaviour and product usage data to identify opportunities for growth, cross-sell, and product optimization. Create and maintain management information dashboards to track client activity, product performance, and key metrics (account growth, AUM, revenue, engagement, retention).
- Develop business cases for new products and features, including market sizing, revenue projections, and implementation requirements. Contribute to strategic planning and roadmap development for IBKR UK product offerings.

Required

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Brand Insight & Effectiveness Team 👋

Our Brand Insight & Effectiveness team helps Trainline stay close to its customers by delivering high-quality research, clear insight and commercially grounded recommendations across our UK and International markets. The team plays an important role in shaping customer-first thinking, helping colleagues understand audiences, evaluate brand and marketing performance, and make confident decisions based on evidence.

As Market Research Lead, you will bring strong quantitative research expertise and a curiosity for how AI-led approaches can improve the way we work. You will lead a varied range of research projects, partner closely with Brand, Marketing, Data Science, UX Research and Effectiveness teams, and help the business turn insight into action across multiple markets.

In this role as the Market Research Lead , you will...🚄

 - Lead quantitative market research projects from brief through to delivery, including survey design, methodology development, analysis and reporting across areas such as audience segmentation, concept and creative testing, brand health tracking and campaign evaluation.

 - Own and evolve key reporting outputs, including the Brand Tracker, ensuring stakeholders are engaged, informed and able to use insights confidently in their decision-making.

 - Analyse and interpret data independently and in partnership with teams such as Data Science, UX Research and Marketing Effectiveness, bringing together multiple sources of evidence to create clear, actionable narratives.

 - Identify opportunities to use AI-led approaches to improve research quality, efficiency and insight generation, helping the team test new ways of working while maintaining strong research standards.

 - Work closely with Senior Brand Managers, Brand Directors and wider Marketing teams to ensure brand and marketing strategies are grounded in relevant customer insight and robust data.

 - Manage third-party research suppliers across qualitative and quantitative projects, from briefing and relationship management through to delivery, budget tracking and ensuring outputs meet business needs.

 - Proactively spot opportunities where research can help answer business questions, shape decisions or unlock a deeper understanding of customers, markets and campaign performance.

 - Support non-research colleagues by building simple processes for self-service projects, such as creative testing, and helping wider teams engage effectively with existing research and data sources.
   
   

 - We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

 - Significant hands-on experience in a market research role, either agency-side, client-side or through an equivalent background, with strong quantitative research capability.

 - Experience implementing, experimenting with or a strong interest in AI-led approaches within market research, insight or marketing effectiveness.

 - Confidence designing research methodologies, writing surveys, analysing data, creating reports and presenting findings in a way that is clear, engaging and tailored to different audiences.

 - The ability to combine multiple data sources, including qualitative and quantitative insight, into a coherent story that gets to the “so what?” and supports business decision-making.

 - Strong communication skills, attention to detail and the ability to translate complex findings into practical recommendations for stakeholders across different teams.

 - Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, suppliers and timelines while keeping work focused on impact.

 - A collaborative approach and confidence working with cross-functional partners such as Brand, Marketing, Data Science, UX Research and Effectiveness teams.

Bonus points if you have...

 - Multi-market research experience across markets such as the UK, France, Italy, Spain or the US

 - Experience using tools such as YouGov Crunch.



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainline/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeattrainline/ and Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Trainline-EI_IE249203.11,20.htm!

Job Description:

We are seeking a Sr. Data Product Leader to support our office.

Job Description

HPE Financial Services (HPEFS) is seeking a Data Product Leader to own the day-to-day execution of treating data as a managed, governed, and intentionally designed product across the HPEFS digital ecosystem. Reporting to the Digital Strategy Leader, this role is responsible for ensuring HPEFS data is trusted, governed, reusable, and AI-ready so that it can be consumed reliably across reporting, analytics, automation, AI-enabled experiences, and digital products. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role and serves as the primary business-side voice for data consumers across Operations, Sales, Credit, Risk, Finance, Compliance, Analytics, and AI-enabled initiatives.

Responsibilities

Data Product Strategy & Roadmap



- Own the data product vision, strategy, and roadmap for HPEFS, aligned to enterprise data-as-a-product direction and broader digital strategy. 
- Define and maintain the enterprise data product portfolio across key business domains, including Customer, Asset, Transaction, Risk, and Operational data. 
- Translate business needs, AI/analytics use cases, and reporting requirements into outcome-based data product requirements using the enterprise Outcome-Based Requirements (OBR) framework. 
- Prioritize the portfolio based on business value potential, reuse, risk reduction, and enablement of downstream analytics, automation, and AI use cases. 
- Align data product priorities with D365, Portals & APIs, Odessa, GPO, Pyramid, and other digital ecosystem initiatives, and continuously reassess the portfolio for new products, enhancements, consolidation, or deprecation. 

Data Product Lifecycle Management



- Own the full data product lifecycle from ideation and design through development, deployment, adoption, iteration, and deprecation. 
- Manage a prioritized backlog with clear acceptance criteria, business outcomes, OKR alignment, and release readiness expectations aligned to enterprise release governance. 
- Define and enforce product standards for quality, SLAs, metadata, lineage, cataloging, access controls, and usage guidance. 
- Ensure data products are reusable, composable, and scalable across consumption channels, including dashboards, APIs, semantic layers, governed datasets, analytical models, and AI-enabled solutions. 

AI & Analytics Enablement



- Ensure HPEFS data products are intentionally designed to support AI, advanced analytics, operational reporting, executive dashboards, automation, and digital product consumption. 
- Define AI-readiness criteria that go beyond baseline data product standards, including semantic clarity, business context, explainability, appropriate-use guidance, and fitness for machine consumption. 
- Ensure consumers understand intended use, known limitations, interpretation guidance, and downstream dependencies for each data product. 
- Translate AI, analytics, and automation needs into practical data product requirements in partnership with business, data science, reporting, and automation teams. 
- Support responsible AI practices by ensuring data used for AI-enabled insights or decisions is traceable, auditable, and risk-aligned. 
- Identify opportunities where trusted data products unlock predictive insights, intelligent workflow automation, customer intelligence, risk visibility, and faster time-to-insight. 

Data Governance & Quality



- Serve as the business-side steward of data governance for assigned domains, ensuring adherence to enterprise policies and standards. 
- Own business glossary definitions, data dictionaries, sensitivity classification, and domain-level metadata for assigned data domains. 
- Define data quality rules, monitoring thresholds, and remediation paths, and drive root cause analysis for issues that impact reporting, AI outputs, or business decisions. 
- Ensure data products comply with regulatory requirements, including AML/KYC, SOX, GDPR, CCPA, and internal audit standards. 
- Partner with the HPE Data Office and IT on governance frameworks, tooling such as Collibra, and enterprise data catalog implementation. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement



- Serve as the primary liaison between data consumers (Operations, Sales, Credit, Risk, Finance, Compliance) and data producers (IT, Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science). 
- Facilitate domain working sessions to capture requirements, validate data product design, and drive alignment on priorities and tradeoffs. 
- Partner with Business Product Managers, Business Analysts, and Process Engineering so data products support end-to-end process and product outcomes. 
- Collaborate with Product Enablement to strengthen data and AI literacy, adoption, and responsible consumption across business teams. 
- Coordinate with the Product Insight/Analytics Lead on shared measurement, dashboards, and value realization reporting; engage external vendors as needed under HPEFS vendor governance. 

Measurement, Adoption & Value Realization



- Define and track KPIs for each data product, including adoption, data quality, consumer satisfaction, time-to-insight, reuse, and business value delivered. 
- Track outcomes tied to enterprise objectives, such as reduced manual reporting, faster insight generation, improved decision confidence, and stronger self-service adoption. 
- Communicate data product updates, roadmap progress, risks, and value realization to the Digital Strategy Leader and senior leadership. 
- Drive product-level continuous improvement through structured feedback loops, usage analytics, and periodic data product reviews. 

Education And Experience Required



- First-level university degree or equivalent experience; advanced university degree preferred (Business, Information Systems, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field). 
- Typically 7+ years of related experience in product management, data management, or data strategy, preferably within financial services, leasing, or fintech. 
- Prior people management experience required, including leading direct reports, matrixed teams, or cross-functional squads; ability to coach, develop talent, and drive accountability across geographies. 
- Demonstrated experience treating data as a product, including defining roadmaps, managing backlogs, and measuring outcomes. 
- Experience partnering across global teams spanning business, IT, data, analytics, and governance stakeholders. 

Knowledge And Skills



- Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, and data catalog concepts. 
- Ability to define AI-ready data product requirements, including semantic clarity, business context, appropriate-use guidance, and fitness for AI, analytics, and reporting consumption. 
- Understanding of responsible AI principles as they relate to governance, privacy, explainability, auditability, and risk management. 
- SQL proficiency and working familiarity with modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric), BI tools, and data catalog/governance tools (e.g., Collibra). 
- Familiarity with AI/ML data consumption patterns, semantic layers, feature stores, vector databases, data APIs, or model-ready datasets. 
- Working knowledge of model risk, data bias, data drift, and explainability concepts. 
- Experience defining common business metrics, semantic models, or reusable analytical datasets across functions. 
- Working knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to financial services (AML/KYC, SOX, GDPR, CCPA). 
- Experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps. 
- Domain knowledge in leasing, asset management, or financial services operations preferred. 
- People leadership skills: coaching, performance management, team development, and driving execution through others. 
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data topics into clear business language and executive-ready narratives. 

Additional Skills

Accountability, Active Listening, Agile Methodology, Business Acumen, Change Management, Coaching, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Data Governance, Data Product Management, Data Quality, Decision Making, Executive Communication, Growth Mindset, Influencing Skills, Leadership, Managing Ambiguity, Outcome-Based Requirements, People Management, Product Management, Responsible AI, Roadmap Planning, Stakeholder Engagement, Strategic Thinking, Talent Development.

What We Can Offer You:

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

As a Senior Product Analyst, You Will



- Influence change by presenting product and customer data-driven insights to product management and senior leadership; confidently present the outcome of your analysis and make recommendations to executives and team leaders.
- Be the right hand of product and business leaders in building business cases for new product functionality, and tracking the effectiveness of the functionality over time; monitor key metrics, identify business trends and generate forecasts.
- Lead deep-dive analysis that will frame product strategy and product roadmap decisions.
- Foster our data-centric, continuous learning culture with your passion for telling stories with data; grow our best practices around reporting quality, data hygiene, and data governance.
- Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing dashboards and their underlying data sets.
- Work collaboratively with product managers and engineers to ensure the right data is generated and collected.

You Should Apply If You Have



- 5+ years of demonstrated experience working as a data or product analyst, preferably at a growing tech company.
- Degree in Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field
- Confirmed ability to surface key insights that subsequently drove business changes with measurable lift in performance.
- Fluency in common statistical analysis methods; and specifically, the ability to quickly separate data from noise.
- Proficiency using SQL and Excel for data querying and manipulation; comfortable using additional data access and analysis tools.
- Experience with product analytics methodologies.
- Passionate about producing high-quality accurate analytics deliverables.
- Ideally, you are experienced in creating and maintaining dashboards using data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or similar.
- Self-motivation, proactively going beyond the call of duty.
- Creativity and strategic thinking.
- The ability to work comfortably in a constantly evolving environment.

What makes the Product Analytics department at Gong unique?

Here at Gong, we trust and empower our employees with ownership to solve complex problems, make the right decisions and build the best products that create radical impact. We call it “Own. Solve. Impact.”

Our decision-making process at Gong is based on data and not on hunches. Therefore you’ll get an opportunity to play a major part in the company's product strategy and operations and to analyze complex, non-trivial data generated in a fast-moving product, which tens of thousands of users use daily or weekly.

If you are curious to discover Gong's wonderful and challenging world, what are you waiting for? Don’t delay - fill in your application details. Who knows, maybe there’s a Gongster in you!

About Us

We encourage our employees to express their personality and identity (whether gender, ethnic, religious, or sexual), and we ensure fairness and equal opportunities. We follow a hybrid working model that combines working from home, on the go, or at the office. This allows us: flexibility, autonomy, positive work relationships, and effective work habits.

If these considerations are important to you when choosing a work place, we'd love to see you with us.

To review Gong's privacy policy, visit www.gong.io/privacy-policy/ for more details.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Delivery Manager to join our newly formed PMO team and own the definition and delivery of a continuous improvement Q. This Q responsible for technical and process change across all Flogas Ireland entities and systems, likely spanning continuous improvement change requests, bug backlogs handed over from projects into BAU, ongoing system maintenance and vendor led upgrades (e.g. MS Dynamics updates).

This is a control and governance role across project management, delivery and vendor management. The Delivery Manager ensures every item in the queue is prioritised correctly (liaising with IT Business Partners) and delivered through a disciplined SDLC process, and holds third-party vendors to account for planning, delivering, and reporting on their work. The role is the primary bridge between vendors delivering the change and the business waiting on it - translating technical/vendor activity into clear updates for stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

Delivery Queue Management



- Act as Project Manager for the Delivery Q. 
- Own and manage definition, prioritisation (with IT Business Partner), and planning / delivery of the Delivery Queue, ensuring small change is captured, assessed, and delivered efficiently across all Flogas Ireland entities and systems
- Manage handover of bugs from project closure or the flow of production SDLC bugs from IT Support
- Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of change requests and minor enhancements, including ongoing maintenance, patching and upgrade activity for core business systems and tools (e.g. MS Dynamics)
- Maintain and continuously improve the intake, triage and prioritisation process for the queue, as this is a newly defined function 
- Manage resource planning for the Delivery Team & business functions as appropriate to delivery

Vendor Relationship Management & Governance



- Act as primary point of contact and relationship owner for in scope third-party vendors/suppliers delivering into the Delivery Queue
- Own vendor planning cycles - ensuring suppliers provide realistic delivery plans, resource forecasts, and commitments for each queue item, and holding them to those commitments
- Creation and monitoring of vendor SLAs/OLAs and contractual delivery commitments, tracking throughput, quality, and responsiveness
- Chair or contribute to regular vendor governance forums (e.g. service reviews, delivery calls) to track progress, resolve blockers, and escalate underperformance
- Identify and manage risks associated with vendor delivery (capacity, quality, dependency, continuity), escalating appropriately

SDLC & Control



- Ensure all queue items - whether delivered internally or by vendors - follow appropriate SDLC process, with clear control points for scoping/prioritisation, design, build, test, and release/deployment
- Ensure changes are appropriately tested and coordinate release/deployment activity with relevant technical teams and vendors
- Maintain appropriate documentation, controls, and audit trail for all changes delivered through the queue
- Ensure lessons learned & improvements are built into the SDLC process

Management & Business Communication



- Provide clear, regular communication back to management & business stakeholders on the status, progress and prioritisation of queue items
- Translate technical and vendor delivery detail into business-friendly updates, managing expectations on timelines and priority
- Track and report on planning, progress, risks / issues, trend analysis via Asana

Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate will have:



- Minimum 5 years experience in a Project Management, technical change, or vendor-facing delivery role, ideally within energy/utilities or a similarly regulated sector
- Strong, demonstrated experience managing third-party vendors/suppliers - planning cycles, SLA creation & monitoring, governance forums, and holding vendors accountable for delivery
- In-depth knowledge and demonstrated experience of SDLC and change control processes
- Proven track record managing a queue/backlog of small-to-medium technical change across multiple systems
- Experience working with or overseeing maintenance/support of business systems (e.g. MS Dynamics, ERP, or similar platforms) desirable
- Strong stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate technical and vendor detail into clear updates for business audiences
- Solid understanding of governance frameworks and controls appropriate to a regulated business
- Proficiency in MS Office is essential, knowledge of Asana, FreshService and Devops desirable

About Flogas:

Part of the DCC Group, Flogas Ireland was established in 1978 supplying Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) throughout the island and to this day remains one of the leading suppliers in Ireland, servicing a diverse range of market sectors, including commercial, agricultural, and domestic.

Over the years, Flogas has evolved and grown as an Energy business, and with the acquisition of Budget Energy, based in Derry, and Flogas Enterprise Solutions, (formally known as Naturgy) we are now also a leading supplier of Natural Gas and Electricity, as well as Renewables, including Corporate Power Purchase Agreements, and energy services in both residential and commercial markets across the island of Ireland. We have an esteemed reputation within the Energy Industry and have been awarded the NSAI Quality System Certificate from the I.S. EN ISO 9001 Series.

As a Flogas Group, we are now driving our growth strategy to achieve our vision of being Irelands leading provider of total energy solutions, meeting our customers changing needs and delivering to the highest possible standard.

Why work with us?

Flogas is a well-established business within the DCC group and is continuing to grow, becoming a top provider in the energy sector, making it a very exciting time to be part of the Flogas Group. We offer a warm and welcoming environment, valuing our people and their input into the business. We encourage a collaborative workplace, where everyone feels included and heard.

Benefits:



- Competitive Salary
- Defined Pension Contribution
- Healthcare Allowance
- Staff discounts
- Hybrid work options
- Health and Wellbeing Supports
- Learning and Development Opportunities
- Career Advancement is important to us in Flogas. All our roles are advertised internally, and we encourage internal progression right across the business. 

Flogas is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Technical Project Manager


Full-time | Dublin, Ireland | Hybrid


About Capri Medical


Capri Medical is a MedTech start-up located in Dublin, Ireland. We create BioElectronics devices which modulate the peripheral nervous system in order to address many of the world's most pressing healthcare needs. Our purpose is to unlock the universality of BioElectronics devices in healthcare treatments.


At Capri Medical, you'll be part of a dynamic, innovative team where your contributions will truly make a real difference in the world. Here, you won't be just a cog in the machine; you'll be an integral part of shaping the future of healthcare. We offer a fast-paced environment that encourages creativity and problem-solving, giving you the opportunity to directly impact patient lives and drive groundbreaking advancements in medical technology. Join us to be a pioneer in the industry, working on cutting-edge projects and seeing the tangible impact of your work on a global scale.


Capri Medical is a multi-award winning startup. We were ranked second in Europe's flagship Innovation Award, the EIC program, which funds Europe's most promising startups. We're looking for talented individuals who thrive in a culture of innovation and empowerment and who are active learners and have a positive attitude. By doing so, we will continue to set new standards in healthcare.


The Role


As Technical Project Manager you will own the planning, coordination and delivery across our implantable device project portfolio, with a particular emphasis on the engineering workstreams. You will be the connective tissue between electronics, mechanical, software, quality and clinical teams as well as external design partners, foundries and contract manufacturers. This is a delivery role for someone who is equally comfortable running a schedule and a risk register as they are reading a schematic or a mechanical drawing and asking the right questions of the engineers who produced it.


Key Responsibilities
Programme planning & delivery

- Own end-to-end project plans for electronics-led development programmes including schedule, resourcing, budget and critical path, and drive them to agreed milestones.
- Coordinate cross-functional workstreams across electronics, mechanical, firmware/software, quality and clinical, keeping dependencies visible and interfaces well defined.
- Run the cadence of stand-ups, phase gates and steering updates, and maintain a single source of truth for status, actions and decisions.
- Coordinate build and test activities and tracking hardware revisions.


Risk, suppliers & stakeholders

- Maintain risk and issue registers, drive mitigations early, and give leadership a clear, honest read on programme health.
- Manage external partners (e.g. contract manufacturers and test labs, including statements of work, deliverables and timelines).
- Communicate to stakeholders at every level, from bench engineers to executives, tailoring detail to the audience.
- Support development within our quality framework


What You'll Bring
Essential

- 8+ years' experience delivering complex electronic or mechanical engineering hardware product development, including a strong track record of project management.
- A degree in electronic, electrical or mechanical engineering (or a closely related discipline), with genuine technical depth.
- Strong electronics grounding. You are comfortable across PCBA, embedded systems, or other active-device electronics.
- Demonstrated ability to run a full development lifecycle from concept through verification and transfer to manufacture, on time and to budget.
- Excellent planning and organisational skills with fluency in project tooling (e.g. Confluence, Jira, or equivalent) and structured risk management.
- Experience in a regulated, hardware-intensive industry such as medical devices, aerospace, automotive, semiconductor or similar.
- Clear, credible communication. You are able to hold the confidence of senior engineers and executives alike.


Desirable

- Experience with active implantable medical devices, wearables or other miniaturised, power-constrained electronics.
- Familiarity with medical device development within an ISO 13485 quality system and design-control ways of working.
- A recognised project management qualification (PMP, PRINCE2, APM or equivalent).
- Experience taking a product from clinical-stage prototype toward commercialisation.


Why Join Capri Medical?

- Be part of a pioneering MedTech company at the forefront of BioElectronics innovation
- Join at a pivotal growth stage with the opportunity to shape processes and systems from the ground up
- Work alongside a passionate, multi-award winning team making a tangible impact on global healthcare
- Enjoy a collaborative, empowering culture that values creativity, initiative, and continuous learning


Capri Medical is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Job Description

Role: Product Operations Manager

Location: Holborn, London

Reports to: Product Operations Director

The opportunity

We're MiQ, a programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. We're experts in data science, analytics and programmatic trading, and we're always ready to react and solve challenges quickly so our clients are always spending their media investments on the right things in the right places.

Our business keeps growing because we keep hiring smart people who challenge conventions, connect teams and make great things happen.

This role sits within Global Product Operations and is designed to help bring together the product organisation as a cohesive unit, making it easier for teams to execute strategy efficiently and improving the experience of doing product work at MiQ.

We're looking for a Product Operations Manager who will work alongside the Product Operations Director as a broad Product Ops generalist - someone who is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves on day-to-day operational improvement and stepping up to independently lead key cross-functional initiatives. You'll help improve the health of how the organisation works, create momentum around important initiatives and make sure execution stays current across the board.

You'll focus on supporting core processes, operating rhythms, tooling, communication and day-to-day operational effectiveness across Global Product and its adjacent teams, while also taking clear ownership of a key initiative or two at any given time.

This is a role for someone who is practical, hands-on and highly collaborative, with the confidence to drive meaningful projects independently and bring structure to complex cross-functional work.

What This Role Is Here To Do

Product Operations at MiQ focuses on people, process and systems, helping the product organisation operate effectively and consistently as it scales.

This role is therefore best suited to someone who enjoys:



- Taking ownership of key operational improvement projects and driving them through to completion
- Spotting where ways of working are unclear, inconsistent or out of date, and helping keep them effective and current
- Bringing structure, visibility and momentum to cross-functional work involving multiple teams and stakeholders
- Working closely with Product Managers and adjacent teams to understand friction, identify improvement opportunities and translate those into action
- Balancing immediate execution support with broader operational improvement across the Product organisation

Job Responsibilities

Your main responsibilities will include:

Process health and continuous improvement



- Support established Product processes and help keep them current, effective and easy for teams to follow
- Take ownership of reviewing and continuously improving key Product processes where needed, ensuring they remain clear, lightweight and useful in practice
- Identify where workflows, handoffs or responsibilities are unclear and help teams close those gaps
- Keep operational processes up to date as team needs, tools and priorities evolve
- Help teams adopt and maintain shared and repeatable ways of working

Rituals, planning and operating cadence



- Review and improve the health of Product rituals and operating cadences
- Help maintain the calendars, checkpoints and recurring workflows that keep Product and Tech operating effectively
- Ensure key operational processes happen consistently, with the right visibility, follow-through and accountability
- Support teams in making execution status, decisions, dependencies and next steps easier to understand

Tooling, systems and operational enablement



- Own and improve the day-to-day operational setup of Product tools and systems
- Identify friction in current tooling or ways of working and work with relevant partners to improve usage, structure, adoption and effectiveness
- Help ensure teams have the right operational support, information and structure to execute effectively
- Contribute to lightweight governance around templates, workflows and operational setup across key tools
- Support practical improvements that make cross-functional work easier to coordinate and maintain

Cross-team coordination



- Stay close to Product Managers and other adjacent teams to understand day-to-day friction, emerging problems and opportunities for improvement
- Help connect the dots across teams so that process changes, priorities and expectations are understood consistently
- Facilitate working sessions and discussions needed to move cross-functional initiatives forward
- Support stronger alignment across Product, Tech and adjacent functions

Project delivery and leadership



- Lead 1–2 key Product Ops projects at any given time, with responsibility for shaping plans, aligning stakeholders and driving progress
- Support the planning and delivery of broader Product Ops projects, helping keep work structured, coordinated and moving forward

6d2d057158df380c.description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.

We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.

By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.

Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

Senior Project Manager - PMO Lead

As Neara scales globally, we are investing in the operational rigor required to maintain excellence across an increasingly complex portfolio of customer engagements. To that end, we are hiring a Senior Project Manager for our European business: a position dedicated to software delivery and project management excellence, internal and customer training, and maintaining the connective tissue between our customer value, solutions and engineering teams.

PMO is a new team that you will shape and operationalize, owning several critical functions which have to date, either operated in a more disaggregated manner or not existed at all. This is an exciting opportunity to build an important part of the Neara engine, with scope to influence global operations strategy as a senior member of the team in one of our fastest growing markets.

What You Will Do



- Own end-to-end delivery for a portfolio of complex, high-value enterprise software implementations, from kickoff through go-live and handover.
- Apply and reinforce project management best practices and standards across your projects, setting the bar for how implementations should run.
- Maintain accurate, up-to-date project tracking and reporting - status, risks, milestones, and value delivery - and roll it up into team-level rituals and leadership dashboards.
- Identify risks and blockers early, and drive them to resolution by coordinating across Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.
- Partner with the VP of CS and the wider CS team to refine PMO tooling, templates, and reporting infrastructure as the function matures.
- Support contract and scope reviews with Product and Engineering to ensure projects are resourced and configured for success from the start.
- Design and maintain Customer Success team onboarding and continuous learning systems.

Who You Are



- 5+ years of project management experience, ideally as a Project Manager, Delivery Manager, Implementation Manager, or Professional Services Manager, within a formal PMO, high-growth software, consulting, or enterprise technology environment.
- Direct experience running enterprise software deployments or large-scale transformation programs, with a clear understanding of what makes complex implementations succeed or fail.
- Track record of applying, and improving, project management standards and processes rather than just operating within an existing framework.
- Comfortable working at multiple altitudes: following a defined methodology one day, unblocking execution on the ground the next.
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex project status, risks, and trade-offs into clear narratives for senior leadership and customers.
- Comfortable with data and tooling - able to build and maintain (automated) reporting, dashboards, and tracking systems, and confident working with project management tools (e.g., Fibery, Jira, Asana, or similar).
- Experience within infrastructure, and specifically the energy sector, is a plus but not essential.
- Fluent in English (must) and other European languages (preferred).

What We Offer



- This is a rare opportunity to help stand up a brand-new PMO function for Neara. You will run some of our most important customer implementations while directly shaping the standards and tooling that scale our customer success operations in our largest market.
- Based in Europe, you will be a key part of our strategic growth in this market and drive the development of a self sustained business.
- Work on technology that matters. Our physics-enabled digital twins are actively protecting global energy grids from increasingly common weather events and structural failure, meaning your operational excellence directly translates to a more resilient world.
- You will have the strategic autonomy to influence global operations, paired with a collaborative culture where everyone, from engineering to leadership, is accessible and aligned on the same mission.

Compensation Range: £100K - £110K
