This role will support the delivery of Loan HQ, State Street’s strategic platform for Loans and Private Credit, by helping shape, prioritise, and execute solutions that improve loan servicing, automate manual processes, strengthen controls, and create a scalable digital operating model for our clients.

Why this role is important to us

The Loan HQ team is part of the Global Delivery Simplification programme and is delivering a strategic, centralised platform that brings together loan controls, workflows, data, reporting, automation, and business processes. The successful candidate will play an important role in translating business needs into deliverable product outcomes, supporting Agile execution, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver high-quality functionality across the Loan HQ roadmap.

Join us if you are ready to make a meaningful contribution to a strategic transformation programme in the loan product space and help shape the future operating model for loan servicing.

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.


THE ROLE

We’ve built a category-defining experience in rail. Now we’re going beyond rail, using design to open new verticals, new journeys and new value for our customers. This brand-new leadership role leads design for that expansion from the ground up. We term that expansion, ‘New Business’ with focus on expanding our strong rail proposition into the worlds of Hotels, Car Hire, Insurance and a building a compelling advertising + media offering.

You’ll join a cross functional leadership team of product, engineering, commercial and data science leaders who’s mission it is to turn Trainline’s New Business ambition from vision into live propositions. You will be responsible for making the Design and UX decisions that allow Trainline to explore and build a presence in new verticals (from hotels to car hire, insurance and more), ensuring the product architecture scales in line with Trainline’s ambition.

It’s a player-coach role. You’ll set the vision and lift your team’s craft while staying close enough to shape the details that decide how new propositions land and integrate into a well-oiled rail ticketing and travel product suite. More broadly you will be the connective force across the wider design org, making sure a portfolio of separate bets cohere into one Trainline experience.




IN THIS ROLE AS THE HEAD OF UX DESIGN, YOU WILL...🚄

 - Build seamless, connected trips. Lead the design of a more connected trip experience for our customers - so they can complete more of their booking beyond rail with Trainline, like hotel, car hire and insurance in one seamless flow.

 - Establish a high experimentation culture. Run a prototyping-and-live-testing cadence that lets us enter spaces we don’t serve today quickly and cost-consciously, knowing which bets deserve a fast probe and which deserve real investment.

 - Connect the portfolio. Surface the threads across our New Business bets and the wider strategy, so a set of new verticals reads as one coherent Trainline UX rather than a scatter of features, working in genuine partnership with product and engineering leaders beyond your immediate group.

 - Put AI at the core of how we work. Be hands-on with AI in your own practice, and partner with UX and product leadership to advance the discipline, turning what works into the default way the team explores, tests and ships new propositions.

 - Hold the bar as we move fast. Bring a world-class eye for detail to brand-new, unproven experiences, and prove craft is what makes a new vertical credible, not a tax on speed.

 - Own the insight that inspires. Define compelling research roadmaps that build rich understanding of customers and journeys we don’t yet serve, and de-risk each new bet before we commit.

 - Build the team behind the expansion. Manage, mentor and hire as the mission scales, shaping a culture that’s comfortable starting from zero.




WE'D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE...🔍

Overview:

VIOTAS is seeking a Senior R&D Programme Manager to further build and lead the programme management capability within VIOTAS Innovation. Reporting to the Director of Innovation, you will help create and manage a clear, prioritised and evidence-led portfolio across technology, product, market, research and strategic-option initiatives.

This is a senior role for someone who combines disciplined programme leadership with commercial judgement, strong stakeholder influence and practical use of AI and data. You will improve delivery visibility, help leaders make investment and resource decisions, identify emerging opportunities and lead engagement with funding bodies.

About VIOTAS:

Established in Limerick, Ireland in 2013, VIOTAS set about designing and delivering new innovations to address the challenges posed by increased renewable generation in electrical grids: How can a grid be balanced when a large amount of electricity is coming from unpredictable renewable sources that are difficult to forecast and that change the fundamental principles of how grids operate?

In response, VIOTAS developed proprietary technologies that place electricity customers at the core of the solution. By managing their electricity consumption and onsite generation in real-time, VIOTAS help balance the wider electricity grid. The company then aggregates participating customers to form Virtual Power Plants which are traded in the electricity market. This approach not only generates significant revenue for participating customers but also contributes to decarbonization of the power system. With a global expansion strategy, VIOTAS, currently with over 110 staff, operates in Ireland, Poland, USA and Australia.

The Role:

Programme manage an integrated Innovation portfolio covering major programmes, products, experiments and funded initiatives.
Coordinate prioritisation, capacity planning, dependency management, scenario analysis and benefits tracking.
Introduce AI-assisted tracking, reporting, risk detection and portfolio optimisation, with appropriate human oversight and governance.
Provide concise, decision-ready reporting to Senior Leadership and the Board.
Lead or assure complex cross-functional programmes and support recovery where delivery is off track.
Build a structured opportunity-scanning process across energy markets, grid services, DER, storage, AI, analytics, cloud, edge technology and cybersecurity.
Programme manage strategic experiments using clear hypotheses, budgets, time limits and scale-or-stop decisions.
Collaborate to identify suitable national and European funding opportunities and lead engagement, applications, delivery governance, claims and reporting.
Develop robust business cases and work with Finance to assess value, cost, risk and strategic option value.
Build a practical, high-value Programme Office that improves decisions without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

What We’re Looking For:

Significant experience leading complex programmes or portfolios in technology, energy, engineering, infrastructure, digital products or another regulated environment.
A strong record of senior stakeholder management, executive reporting and evidence-based prioritisation.
Experience with business cases, programme finances, benefits, risks, dependencies and governance.
Practical experience applying AI, automation or advanced analytics to delivery or operational workflows.
Experience engaging with funding bodies and coordinating funding applications or funded programmes.
The judgement and confidence to challenge assumptions, redirect resources and recommend when work should be paused or stopped.
A recognised programme or project-management qualification, or equivalent professional experience.

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent.

Location: Limerick or Dublin, Ireland (Hybrid)

Compensation & Benefits: Competitive package, including base salary, performance bonus and benefits, commensurate with experience.

87261483b22baca7.description:
Circit is a Series B B2B SaaS company on a mission to make business verifiable in real-time. We have built a global asset verification platform trusted by Big Four firms, global banks and their corporate clients to transform audit and financial workflows.

Our growth has been powered by strong product-market fit and powerful network effects across auditors, financial institutions and corporates. As our platform scales globally, the speed and quality with which we bring new customers to value has become a critical operational advantage.

We are building out a dedicated Implementation function sitting within the COO organisation, with a clear and focused mission: get customers live, confident and successful on Circit as quickly as possible.

This team operates as a specialist delivery , which handles both pilots and full roll outs. A well-run implementation is critical to the future success and growth of the account. Once a customer is live, stable and in a healthy state, they graduate to the Customer Success team who own the long-term relationship. Implementation is the engine that makes that handover possible.

We are looking for an Implementation Manager to own the customer journey from kick-off through to a successful, well-documented handover — delivering a consistent, high-quality experience across both direct rollouts and pilot engagements that sets every customer up to thrive.

As Implementation Manager for the European market, you will own the end-to-end customer journey from kick-off through to handover to Customer Success, across two types of engagement: direct rollouts, where customers are ready to go live immediately, and pilot programmes, where a successful implementation is the key factor in a larger commercial decision. You will sit within the Implementation team under the COO, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver a structured, technically rigorous and customer-first experience in both tracks.

You are the face of Circit for new customers in their most critical early weeks. You will run kick-offs, manage timelines, coordinate internal resources, deliver training and own the relationship until the customer is healthy, active and ready to transition to Customer Success.

You will work across some of the world's most prestigious financial institutions and accounting firms — managing complex, multi-stakeholder implementations while continuously improving the playbooks and processes that allow the team to scale.

Requirements

Implementation & Pilot Management



- Own the customer journey from kick-off through to successful handover to Customer Success across both direct rollouts and pilot engagements, ensuring every account reaches a clearly defined healthy state
- Lead kick-off sessions, project planning and stakeholder alignment with new customers from Day 1
- Ensure that the account is configured in such a way that allow for maximum growth potential in future years
- Manage multiple concurrent implementations across enterprise and mid-market accounts — some direct rollouts, some pilots — coordinating timelines, milestones and resources across the wider Implementation team
- For pilot engagements, work closely with Sales to define success criteria upfront, scope the configuration and ensure the pilot is structured to demonstrate clear, measurable value — giving the customer everything they need to make a confident commercial decision
- On pilot engagements, own the relationship and momentum throughout — tracking progress against agreed success criteria and ensuring any issues are resolved quickly so they don't jeopardise the commercial outcome
- Manage the technical configuration and product customisation required for each engagement — whether a direct rollout or a pilot — tailoring the platform to each customer's specific workflows and requirements
- Deliver engaging product training sessions (remote and on-site) for end users, champions and admin teams
- Own the post-go-live Hypercare period, monitoring adoption and resolving issues until accounts meet the health criteria required for CS handover
- Maintain clear, accurate handover documentation so Customer Success can take over relationships with full context and confidence

Product Expertise



- Develop deep, comprehensive knowledge of the Circit platform — every workflow, configuration option and feature — so you can confidently guide customers through any scenario they encounter
- Use that product knowledge to recommend the right configuration and setup for each customer — understanding their specific workflows, team structures and use cases well enough to tailor the implementation accordingly
- Deliver high-quality, credible product training that goes beyond the basics — anticipating customer questions, explaining the "why" behind features and helping teams build genuine confidence in the platform
- Stay current as the product evolves — proactively learning new features, understanding their implications for existing customers and updating onboarding materials and training to reflect the latest platform capabilities
- Act as an internal product authority within the Implementation team, helping colleagues navigate edge cases and sharing knowledge that raises the bar for the whole team

Team Collaboration & Coordination



- Collaborate closely with product, sales, support and customer success to coordinate workstreams, share load effectively and deliver consistent outcomes
- Work with the COO and leadership team to refine handover criteria, processes, and maintain a clear definition of a ‘healthy' account ready for Customer Success, across both rollout and pilot tracks
- Partner with the Customer Success team to ensure smooth, well-informed transitions and a seamless experience for the customer throughout
- Work closely with Sales on both tracks — ensuring clean handovers with the right customer context for direct rollouts, and on pilot engagements, maintaining alignment on success criteria and providing visibility throughout so the broader commercial relationship is well managed

Playbooks, Process & Continuous Improvement



- Build and refine onboarding SOPs, implementation guides and customer-facing documentation to support a growing volume of onboardings
- Identify patterns across implementations to reduce time-to-value, remove friction and improve the consistency of outcomes
- Contribute to scalable onboarding tooling, portal content and self-serve resources that reduce manual effort and improve the customer experience
- Maintain accurate project records and reporting within CRM and project management tools (Hubspot, Asana)

Voice of the Customer



- Surface insights from onboarding engagements to inform product improvements, support resources and operational decisions
- Identify expansion signals during onboarding and flag them appropriately to the Customer Success or Account Management team
- Represent the customer's perspective in internal conversations, advocating for changes that improve time-to-value and reduce early-stage churn risk

Qualifications And Experience

We are looking for someone who brings structure, initiative and genuine customer empathy to every implementation. You are highly organised, confident managing complexity, and motivated by seeing customers succeed.



- 3-6 years of experience in a customer-facing role in B2B SaaS — ideally in onboarding, implementation, professional services or technical project management
- Experience managing enterprise pilots or proof-of-concept engagements in a commercial context is a strong advantage — you understand that a well-run pilot is as much about confidence-building as it is about technical delivery
- Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder onboarding or implementation projects end-to-end, with clear accountability for outcomes
- Experience running enterprise pilots or proof-of-concept engagements is a strong advantage — you understand how to structure them for success and what it takes to move a customer from evaluating to committed
- Comfortable working within a team, coordinating effectively across different skill sets
- Strong project management skills — you can run multiple workstreams simultaneously and keep projects on track without losing sight of the customer experience
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — comfortable presenting to senior audiences, managing expectations and building rapport at all levels
- Experience working with enterprise or regulated-industry customers is a strong advantage (audit, financial services, legal or similar)
- Familiarity with onboarding or project management tooling (e.g. HubSpot, Stonrylane, Asana or similar)
- A builder's mindset — you improve processes as you go, not just follow them
- A genuine curiosity for product — you take pride in knowing the platform inside out and see deep product knowledge as a core part of doing this role well
- Comfortable in a fast-paced, scaling environment where structure is still being built and initiative is rewarded

Benefits

This is a unique opportunity to join a newly formed, high-impact function at the operational core of Circit's growth — with the autonomy to shape how world-class implementations are delivered at scale.



- Competitive salary
- Healthcare and pension
- Hybrid and flexible working
- High autonomy and ownership within a specialist delivery team
- Opportunity to build and refine the onboarding practice from an early stage
- Work with some of the world's leading financial institutions and accounting firms
- Be part of a mission-driven, Series B company at an exciting inflection point

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Finance Team 👋

At Trainline, our Finance team is the backbone of how we manage, govern, and grow the business responsibly. From transactional processing to financial controls and systems ownership, the team works across a broad range of disciplines to ensure Trainline operates with accuracy, integrity, and commercial rigour. This is a pivotal interim appointment within our operational finance function, sitting within a high-performing team and reporting directly to the Group Financial Controller.

As Interim Senior Operational Finance Manager, you will lead the teams responsible for Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Finance Systems, and our Cashbook function, driving operational excellence and embedding a continuous improvement mindset across the function. You will work closely with Finance leadership and Technology colleagues to strengthen controls, streamline processes, and maintain delivery momentum throughout a six-month fixed-term engagement, with a clear and structured handover at its close.

In this role as the Interim Senior Operational Finance Manager, you will...🚄

 - Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary operational finance team across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Finance Systems, and Cashbook, setting clear objectives, managing team capacity, and actively supporting the professional growth of every team member.

 - Own the day-to-day management of the AP and AR functions, ensuring invoices, payments, collections, and reconciliations are processed accurately, on time, and in line with strong governance and compliance standards.

 - Drive working capital performance by monitoring AP and AR KPIs, proactively managing aged debt and debtor days, and delivering regular reporting and insight to the Group Financial Controller.

 - Oversee bank and cash reconciliation across all entities and currencies, maintaining robust controls over cash processes including payment authorisation, segregation of duties, and reconciliation review.

 - Act as business owner for Trainline's core finance systems, ensuring platforms are scalable, secure, and well-governed, and that teams are empowered to use them effectively through training and change management.

 - Own the operational finance contribution to month-end close, ensuring ledgers are closed accurately and on time, and serve as a key point of contact throughout internal and external audit processes.

 - Identify and deliver process improvements with a focus on automation, efficiency, and scalability, coordinating with the Senior Finance Manager - Transformation to ensure changes are aligned with the broader Finance transformation roadmap.

 - Build trusted relationships across Finance, Technology, and the wider business, acting as the senior point of contact for operational finance and managing SLAs with internal stakeholders.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

 - Substantial experience managing operational finance functions, ideally spanning Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and finance systems in a fast-paced commercial environment.

 - A strong track record of leading and developing high-performing finance teams, with the ability to set direction, manage performance, and support the professional growth of team members.

 - Solid expertise across AP/AR processes, credit control, working capital management, and financial controls, with a high standard of attention to detail and data governance.

 - Experience working within an ERP environment, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 or a comparable platform, with a confident grasp of transactional finance processes end-to-end.

 - A process improvement mindset, with demonstrated success delivering automation and efficiency gains across operational finance functions.

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and senior business leadership.

 - Confidence managing SLAs and service expectations with internal stakeholders, alongside the resilience to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

 - Availability at short notice and comfort operating in an interim capacity, with the drive to take ownership quickly, deliver impact within a defined timeframe, and lead a clear and structured handover.



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainline/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeattrainline/ and Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Trainline-EI_IE249203.11,20.htm!

Why Faculty? 

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About The Team

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions.

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Developed Vetting (DV) and willing to work on site with our clients from time to time.

About The Role

As a Delivery Manager in our National Security and Safety team at Faculty, you will act as a pivotal commercial and delivery lead, driving high-stakes AI transformation for the UK’s most critical government partners.

You will be a strategic architect, building deep networks of influence and solving complex challenges by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research and operational mission needs.

With an entrepreneurial spirit, you will exceed ambitious growth targets while mentoring multidisciplinary teams to ensure every project delivers meaningful, long-term value in a fast-evolving national security landscape.

What You'll Be Doing



- Owning the end-to-end delivery of customer projects, from initial scoping to final implementation.
- Collaborating with technical teams and government partners to design innovative AI solutions that solve their most pressing mission challenges.
- Managing project development and ensuring a delivery approach that provides maximum value to the national security community.
- Forming strong, trusting relationships with customers, internal data scientists, and technical partners to translate research into operational impact.
- Developing and executing compelling proposals to grow our footprint and impact across the national security sector.
- Advising clients on AI strategy and technical implementation, acting as a trusted partner and consultant in high-stakes environments.
- Mentoring your peers and taking a proactive role in building robust processes and practices within the team.

Who We're Looking For



- You bring a solid foundation in the National Security domain, with a passionate interest in how AI can transform high-stakes decision-making and public safety.
- You possess experience in consultancy or service-based delivery, allowing you to manage complex project lifecycles and meet critical deadlines under pressure.
- You take full responsibility for the successful delivery of your projects, from initial scoping to end-user adoption within government.
- You are an exceptional communicator, with outstanding skills in managing senior stakeholders and translating complex concepts for non-technical audiences.
- You are comfortable working with technical teams and have a proven track record of delivering technical projects, ideally in AI.
- You are a practical problem-solver, identifying potential risks to national security missions and proactively implementing solutions.

The Interview Process



- Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)
- Introduction Interview (60 minutes) 
- Case Study Interview (60 minutes) 

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some Of Our Standout Benefits



- Unlimited Annual Leave Policy
- Private healthcare and dental
- Enhanced parental leave
- Family-Friendly Flexibility & Flexible working
- Sanctus Coaching
- Hybrid Working

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

The Engagement Manager role is a critical role within the TEKsystems Global Services (TGS) Practice Delivery organization and is responsible for managing one or more projects/engagements at a time. A successful Engagement Manager possesses skillsets for managing teams, client facing, stakeholder management, delivery processes, issue resolution for all customer engagements. The delivery function varies in responsibility from account to account, but a successful Engagement Manager is responsible for common activities such as on/off boarding of team members, people management, customer management & reporting, finance management, support project team member activities, issue resolution and supporting other Delivery leads within the account portfolio, and project/engagements. The Engagement Manager assumes accountability of meeting customer expectations, delivery assurance of scope of services, deliverables, and all-round outcomes from the engagements. The Engagement Manager is responsible for qualifying and quantifying the business value benefits from the project outcome throughout the engagement.
They are expected to have the skills required for managing complex deliverable-based, fully outsourced, or scale engagements or programs.
The responsibilities listed below are not exhaustive, as each account will state their unique requirements in the Statement of Work (SoW) or as defined with the Account team at the start of the project.


Key Responsibilities


Delivery Management:

- Delivery of the Engagement, SoW requirements and deliverables as defined by customer.
- Understand SoWs/MSAs and importance of staying on top of the engagement activities & deliverables to meet the expectations of the customer.
- Collaborate with cross functional teams to manage risk, engagement scope, and deliver according to the terms and conditions of our contracts.
- Manage revenue and control, cost & profitability for assigned engagement(s).
- Consolidate and provide engagement delivery reporting as per the Customer engagement needs via a Monthly and/or Quarterly Business Reviews (MBR/QBR).

- Set and manage timekeeping processes, delivery expectations with consultants.
- Follow and adhere to relevant delivery framework to ensure all aspects of the engagement delivery are covered.
- Facilitating group sessions with consultants to share best practices, technical solution recommendations, case studies and build support network community.


Account & Customer Management:

- Establish and perform periodic customer, engagement, and solution "health checks" baselined against the target metrics/expectations associated with the value streams.
- Accountable for customer engagement requirements to deliver and meet or exceed customer expectations.
- Participate in Account Strategy with internal stakeholders relative to engagement status, opportunities, and imminent risks.
- Establish and support reporting cadences, status reports, RAID log, and budgetary documentation.
- Facilitate the collaboration between the Customer, Consultants and TGS Practice groups to extend the support as required.
- Co-ordinate with cross-functional teams to keep the consultant's forum together, networking, share best practices, driving relevant newsletters, lunch & learn sessions etc.
- Maintain awareness for additional business opportunities and support pursuit of future business through quality results and escalation to internal stakeholders when additional business opportunities may present themselves.


Management Responsibilities:

- Act as a servant leader in leading/directing delivery activities across multiple engagements.
- Consolidate engagement status and budget information across the portfolio.
- Develop and maintain engagement related documentation including processes, tools, and procedures in accordance with the TGS delivery framework.
- Understand and manage customer requirements (deliverables) to ensure contract compliance and customer satisfaction.

- Support of other engagements and/or delivery team members as required.

- Collaborating with recruiters and Account Managers in preparation for new starters joining client teams and issue resolution as needed.
- Performance tracking, management, and reporting as requested.
- Collaboration with cross function teams to onboard/off-board consultant onto Customer and TGS IT systems (Email, MS Teams, SharePoint etc.,)


Requisite Abilities and/or Skills



- Analysis and problem-solving skills
- Time management and organizational skills
- Personnel and team management skills
- Demonstrable engagement data/ risk analysis and correlation/ mitigation skills
- Excellent customer service and stakeholder management skills


Basic Qualifications and Experience



- Bachelor's degree, Masters is preferable.
- IT experience, customer project/engagement delivery exposure, and agile methodologies awareness.
- Experience managing and delivering professional managed services to Customer.
- Greenfield development, Application modernization, Cloud technologies awareness
- Experience working with Cloud service providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), hosting solutions, offerings, modernization & migration & strategies is a plus
- Understanding of managed services model, risk, accountability, responsibility expectations
- Agile, Project & Engagement Management experience and any training / certifications on Agile, PMI, SAFe, PRINCE2 is a plus.
- AWS, Azure or GCP Certifications is a plus
- Stakeholder management, team leading, organizing, coaching and Listening skills.
- Understanding of IT environments and able to demonstrate initiative in challenging project situations to provide continual improvement throughout the delivery of services
- Experience working with onsite, offshore, nearshore remote teams
- Behavioral Competencies and Responsibilities
- Customer-first mindset


Collaborates:

- Partners with Delivery Managers, Account Managers, Account Directors, Solution Executives and Business Development Managers to manage risk and ensure we are delivering to the terms and conditions of our contract
- Participates in monthly financial review meetings with Back Office


Communicates Effectively:

- Proactively contributes to customer/account discussions and attends relevant account meetings


Instills Trust

Action Orientated

Description

Program Manager responsible for driving cross-functional program delivery across EMEA infrastructure supply chain operations. Owns coordination and execution of complex, multi-workstream programs spanning logistics, warehousing, vendor management, and data center fulfillment. Reports to Sr Mgr, EMEA AWS Cloud Logistics.

Key job responsibilities



-  Drive cross-functional coordination across internal teams (logistics operations, procurement, engineering, trade compliance, finance) and external partners (carriers, LSPs, warehouse operators, contractors) to deliver program outcomes on time and within scope.
-  Build and maintain program plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and milestone trackers that provide clear visibility on status, blockers, and critical path across all active workstreams.
-  Establish and own program reporting cadences (WBR/MBR/QBR), synthesizing progress across multiple workstreams into executive-level narratives with clear escalation of risks and decisions required.
-  Identify and proactively manage cross-program dependencies, resource conflicts, and sequencing challenges — escalating early and proposing tradeoff options when programs are at risk.
-  Design and implement program governance frameworks, intake processes, and delivery mechanisms where none exist — creating repeatable, scalable structures that reduce coordination overhead and drive consistent execution.
-  Partner with technical and systems teams to improve program tooling, reporting automation, and data quality — translating manual tracking into scalable solutions.
-  Drive continuous improvement across program delivery practices, capturing lessons learned, refining processes, and raising the bar on delivery predictability and stakeholder communication.
-  Operate with a high degree of independence, prioritizing based on business impact, managing competing demands across the portfolio, and escalating only when executive decision-making is required.

A day in the life



-  Run a cross-functional / regional sync to drive progress on a multi-partner program (e.g., a new warehouse stand-up, a logistics network change, or a capacity expansion initiative), documenting actions and owners.
-  Dive deep into a program blocker — pulling together the right stakeholders, diagnosing the root cause, and proposing a path to resolution with clear owners and timelines.
-  Update program plans and risk registers, preparing materials for an upcoming leadership review with a clear narrative on what's on track, what's at risk, and what decisions are needed.
-  Coordinate with procurement and vendor teams to ensure external partner deliverables are sequenced correctly and SLA commitments are being met.
-  Partner with a technology team to scope an automation opportunity that eliminates a recurring manual coordination bottleneck in the program lifecycle.
-  Facilitate a retrospective on a recently completed program, capturing what worked, what didn't, and what mechanisms should be adopted for future programs.

About The Team

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing, high-impact team within AWS Cloud Logistics EMEA. The team manages the end-to-end supply chain for AWS infrastructure across the EMEA region — ensuring the right equipment reaches the right data center at the right time, cost, and quality. The breadth and complexity of our network continues to grow, and we need program managers who can operate across workstreams, geographies, and partner ecosystems to keep our delivery engine running and make it better.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Basic Qualifications



-  Experience in program or project management
-  Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
-  Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
-  Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications



-  Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
-  Experience leading process improvements
-  Knowledge of general AI tools
-  Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

Introducing Machine Learning & AI at Trainline 👋

Machine learning and AI are at the core of how Trainline is transforming travel, helping millions of customers make smarter, more sustainable journeys every day. Our ML models and AI solutions power critical aspects of our platform, including:

 - Advanced search and recommendations capabilities across our mobile and web applications

 - Pricing and routing optimisations to find the best fares for customers

 - Personalised user experiences enhanced by agentic AI

 - Data-driven digital marketing systems

 - AI agents improving customer support

Our machine learning teams own the complete delivery lifecycle from ideation to production. We work closely with stakeholders across the business to expand the understanding and impact of machine learning and AI throughout Trainline.



About The Role

We are looking for Machine Learning Engineers to join our team help shape the future of train travel. You’ll be joining a high-performing, deeply technical community of Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers to tackle complex problems by combining Trainline’s rich datasets with cutting edge algorithms. What unites our team is an expertise in the field, a love of what we do and the desire to create impactful solutions to support Trainline’s goals of encouraging sustainable travel.

As a part of Trainline you will be joining an environment where learning and development is top priority. You will have the opportunity to work with fellow ML & AI enthusiasts on large-scale production systems, delivering highly impactful products that make a difference to our millions of customers.



As a Machine Learning Engineer at Trainline you will... 🚄

 - Work in cross-functional teams combining data scientists, software, data and machine learning engineers, and product managers

 - Design and deliver machine learning models and/or AI solutions at scale that drive measurable impact for Trainline

 - Own the full end-to-end machine learning delivery lifecycle including data exploration, feature engineering, model selection and tuning, offline and online evaluation, deployments and maintenance

 - Partner with stakeholders to propose innovative data products that leverage Trainline’s extensive datasets and state of the art algorithms

 - Create the tools, frameworks and libraries that enables the acceleration of our ML & AI products delivery and improve our workflows

 - Take an active part in our AI and ML community and foster a culture of rigorous learning and experimentation

We'd love to hear from you if you...🔍

 - Have an advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a similar quantitative discipline

 - Are proficient with Python, including open-source data libraries (e.g Pandas, Numpy, Scikit learn etc.)

 - Have experience productionising machine learning models and/or AI solutions

 - Are an expert in one of predictive modelling, classification, regression, optimisation, NLP algorithms or recommendation systems

 - Have experience with Spark

 - Have knowledge of DevOps technologies such as Docker and Terraform and ML Ops practices and platforms like ML Flow

 - Have experience with agile delivery methodologies and CI/CD processes and tools

 - Have a broad of understanding of data extraction, data manipulation and feature engineering techniques

 - Are familiar with statistical methodologies

 - Have great communication skills

Nice to have:

 - Experience with transport industry and/or geographical information systems (GIS)

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure

 - Experience with Large Language Models (fine tuning, RAG, agents)

 - Experience with graph technology and/or algorithms



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey

Eaton’s ES EMEA CPS division is currently seeking a Program Manager Direct Current for Data Center (DC for DC) EMEA.

Role Summary

The DC for DC EMEA Program Manager is responsible for orchestrating and governing Eaton’s end to end data center electrical solution portfolio for hyperscale and colocation customers across EMEA. This role ensures that product development, system architectures, and customer engagement activities across multiple Eaton divisions are aligned into a coherent, competitive, and execution ready offering.

Operating as a senior, technical program leader with strong systems engineering credibility, the Program Manager leads through influence across R&D, product management, engineering, and commercial teams. The role owns program execution from concept through launch, ensuring on schedule and on budget delivery, structured customer engagement at each development milestone, and rapid identification and resolution of technical or organizational gaps.

This is a newly created, strategic role reporting directly to the VP/GM, with a mandate to strengthen Eaton’s position with hyperscalers and colocation customers by driving integrated solutions rather than disconnected products.

What You’ll Do

DC for DC EMEA Program Leadership:



-  Establish and lead the DC for DC EMEA program covering Eaton’s full data center power value chain, including MVSST, 800VDC Switchboard, DC Remote Power Panel, Solid State Breakers, BESS, Busway, digital power management, and related software and services.
-  Define clear program governance, milestones, success criteria, and escalation mechanisms across participating divisions.
-  Ensure the program is executed on schedule and within approved budgets, with disciplined tracking of progress, risks, and dependencies.


Cross Division Product & Technology Alignment



-  Coordinate new product development roadmaps across multiple Eaton divisions to ensure architectural coherence and compatibility for hyperscale and colocation data center applications.
-  Work closely with divisional R&D, power systems engineering, and product management teams to align technical assumptions, interfaces, and performance targets.
-  Identify portfolio gaps, overlaps, or misalignments impacting customer requirements and drive resolution through structured action plans and executive escalation where required.


Customer Engagement & External Alignment



-  Ensure structured and continuous customer engagement throughout the product and solution development lifecycle, including concept validation, architecture reviews, pilot phases, and launch readiness.
-  Act as a senior technical interface for hyperscale and colocation customers in EMEA, ensuring customer feedback is systematically captured and translated into product and program actions.
-  Coordinate with regional teams in APAC and the Americas to align customer learnings, program progress, and best practices globally.


Program Execution, Visibility & Issue Resolution



-  Consolidate inputs from divisions into clear program dashboards, executive summaries, and decision materials for senior leadership.
-  Proactively identify technical, organizational, or execution risks and lead cross functional teams to resolve issues before customer or market impact.
-  Drive disciplined follow up on actions, ensuring accountability and closure across divisional stakeholders.


Strategic Contribution & Continuous Improvement



-  Contribute to Eaton’s long term data center strategy by providing insights from customer engagements, competitive dynamics, and technology trends.
-  Support continuous improvement of Eaton’s data center go to market model by strengthening integration between product, engineering, and customer facing teams.


Qualifications



-  Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Systems Engineering; Master’s degree preferred.
-  Minimum 10–15 years of experience in power systems, electrical infrastructure, or data center technology environments.
-  Proven experience working with hyperscale and/or colocation data center customers.
-  Prior experience in R&D, advanced engineering, systems engineering, or complex technical program leadership roles.


Skills



-  Strong understanding of data center electrical architectures, including MV and LV distribution, ACBs, UPS systems, energy storage, busway, and redundancy concepts.
-  Ability to ensure system level technical coherence through collaboration with divisional experts rather than hands on detailed design ownership.
-  Credibility based leadership and the ability to lead through influence in a matrix organization.
-  Strong program management discipline and executive communication skills.
-  Ability to operate confidently with senior internal leaders and demanding external customers.
-  Structured, action oriented mindset with a strong bias toward execution and issue resolution.
-  Excellent written and spoken English.

 - Support non-research colleagues by building simple processes for self-service projects, such as creative testing, and helping wider teams engage effectively with existing research and data sources.
   
   

 - We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

 - Significant hands-on experience in a market research role, either agency-side, client-side or through an equivalent background, with strong quantitative research capability.

 - Experience implementing, experimenting with or a strong interest in AI-led approaches within market research, insight or marketing effectiveness.

 - Confidence designing research methodologies, writing surveys, analysing data, creating reports and presenting findings in a way that is clear, engaging and tailored to different audiences.

 - The ability to combine multiple data sources, including qualitative and quantitative insight, into a coherent story that gets to the “so what?” and supports business decision-making.

 - Strong communication skills, attention to detail and the ability to translate complex findings into practical recommendations for stakeholders across different teams.

 - Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, suppliers and timelines while keeping work focused on impact.

 - A collaborative approach and confidence working with cross-functional partners such as Brand, Marketing, Data Science, UX Research and Effectiveness teams.

Bonus points if you have...

 - Multi-market research experience across markets such as the UK, France, Italy, Spain or the US

 - Experience using tools such as YouGov Crunch.



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainline/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeattrainline/ and Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Trainline-EI_IE249203.11,20.htm!

Job Description & Summary

About the team

Our Public Sector Transformation Excellence team supports public sector clients to design, deliver and implement transformation programmes. Our work spans project and programme delivery, operating model and service improvement, stakeholder engagement, implementation planning, change readiness, governance and benefits-focused delivery.

We are seeking a Project Manager at Senior Consultant or Assistant Manager level to join our Public Sector Transformation Excellence team. This role will support the delivery of transformation, change and implementation projects for public sector clients in Ireland and internationally. You will work with consulting colleagues and client stakeholders to manage project delivery, coordinate workstreams, maintain governance, analyse evidence, prepare high-quality deliverables and develop practical recommendations that help public sector organisations improve services and deliver better outcomes.

Embrace the possibility to apply – at Grant Thornton we are constantly upskilling our staff. If you do not meet all of the listed requirements, please do not be discouraged from applying. We value a growth-oriented mindset and are dedicated to supporting you in reaching your full potential.

Responsibilities

You will collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team to deliver public sector transformation and advisory projects across a range of client priorities, including:

Project and Client Delivery

Lead and support the delivery of transformation, change and implementation projects for public sector clients, working collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders.

Act as a day-to-day point of contact for clients, supporting clear communication, managing project queries and building strong working relationships.

Conduct in-depth research and data analysis to inform strategic solutions for public sector organisations, including analysis of sector trends, regulation and operational data.

Translate research, evidence and stakeholder input into practical recommendations tailored to each client’s operating context.

Prepare high-quality presentations, reports and other deliverables that communicate project findings, insights and recommendations clearly to clients and senior stakeholders.

Practice Growth, Risk and Team Leadership

Contribute to proposals, tender documentation, business development activities and marketing initiatives that support the growth of Public Sector Transformation Excellence.

Identify and manage project risks and issues, escalate them appropriately and work with the team to develop effective mitigation strategies.

Prepare and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, reports, RAID logs and status updates.

Work closely with cross-functional teams to achieve project objectives and mentor junior team members, providing guidance and support as required.

Monitor developments across the public sector, including regulatory change, policy priorities, market shifts and emerging technologies, and share relevant insights to inform project strategies.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience

Essential experience and skills

A third-level degree, with a strong academic record.

Typically 2 to 5 years’ relevant experience in project management, consulting, transformation, public sector delivery or a related field.

Appointment at Senior Consultant or Assistant Manager level will depend on depth of experience, delivery track record, stakeholder management capability and evidence of leading workstreams or supporting junior colleagues.

Proven project and/or programme management experience, preferably within a public sector organisation, consulting firm or professional services environment.

Demonstrated ability to manage projects through the full lifecycle, from initiation to closure, delivering successful outcomes within agreed scope, timeline and budget.

Excellent analytical capability, including the ability to assess complex information, develop actionable insights and support evidence-based decision-making.

Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, senior stakeholders and multi-disciplinary teams.

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing clear reports, presentations, proposals and tender documents.

Strong organisation, time management and prioritisation skills, with consistent attention to quality and detail.

Ability to balance strategic, big-picture thinking with detailed execution, ensuring that delivery remains aligned with client expectations.

A self-motivated, solution-focused approach to your work, with the initiative to identify challenges, implement effective solutions and work independently or as part of a team.

A proactive and curious approach to identifying business opportunities and contributing to the growth of Public Sector Transformation Excellence.

Desirable experience and certifications

A project management certification is desirable, together with the ability to apply recognised practices, tools and methodologies such as PRINCE2, Agile or tailored approaches.

A change management certification is desirable, such as Prosci Change Management Certification, Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) or Change Management Practitioner (CMP).

We are particularly interested in candidates with extensive experience leading major programmes, projects and transformation initiatives within the utilities sector, including water, electricity and gas. Project Management Delivery

Extensive experience working in the utilities sector, with knowledge of its regulatory, operational and commercial landscape.

Proven ability to direct and deliver complex, multi-stakeholder programmes across the full project lifecycle, including strategic transformation, operational improvement, and capital investment initiatives within utility organisations.

Experience in process analysis and design, including as-is and to-be process mapping, process performance design, implementation, optimisation and continuous improvement.

Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior executives and strategic stakeholders, shaping strategy as well as delivering operational outcomes.
Strong organisational and multi-tasking abilities, with experience managing multiple priorities and delivering in complex, fast-paced environments.
Significant experience in originating, leading and closing business development opportunities, including utilities sector tenders and complex multi-stakeholder bids.
Expertise in senior stakeholder engagement, including government departments, regulators, industry bodies and C-Suite / Senior Management.
An ability to balance big-picture thinking with acute attention to detail, translating long-term objectives into practical and deliverable solutions.
A strong interest in the future of the utilities sector and in helping clients navigate emerging challenges and opportunities through innovation and transformation.
Experience developing and growing client accounts within the utilities sector, with an established professional network and a strong understanding of market trends, client priorities and emerging opportunities.
A creative, problem-solving mindset and initiative-driven approach.

Location: Dublin, Ireland

Work Arrangement: Hybrid – minimum 3 days per week office attendance required

Territory: Global
Reporting to: Technical Team Lead

About Daon

Daon is a global leader in the defence against digital identity fraud and AI-generated synthetic identities. For over a quarter of a century, we have partnered with governments and leading enterprises to deliver secure, seamless identity experiences across financial services, telecommunications, healthcare, travel, and critical infrastructure.

Our TrustX platform enables organisations to orchestrate secure, scalable, cross-channel identity workflows, supporting identity verification, biometric authentication, and lifecycle management across complex environments. More than two billion identities worldwide have been safeguarded by Daon technology.

Recognised as a leading provider by multiple analyst firms including Gartner®, Kuppinger Cole, and Frost & Sullivan®, Daon is at the forefront of shaping the future of identity security.

Role Overview:

As a Senior Java Developer on our TrustX SaaS platform, you will design, build, and improve cloud‑based backend services that power our identity verification and authentication and voice solutions. This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, understands end‑to‑end system flows, and collaborates closely with frontend engineers, architects, DevOps, mobile teams, and QA to deliver reliable, performant, secure software.

We’re looking for strong engineers, not just deep Java specialists. You should be capable of understanding how components interact across the stack, how data flows through the system, and how to make technical decisions that balance performance, scalability, maintainability, and product needs.

You will also be expected to embrace AI‑assisted development, including GitHub Copilot and other modern AI tools, to accelerate coding, improve quality, and help the team work more efficiently.

If you want to contribute to a high‑impact SaaS platform, and you enjoy both building features and shaping technical direction, you’ll thrive here.

What you will do:

Backend Development and Collaboration

Design, develop, and maintain backend services built primarily with Java and Spring Boot.
Implement REST APIs, service integrations, data processing pipelines, and backend logic supporting our core platform capabilities.
Write maintainable, testable, and well‑structured code using modern engineering practices.
Collaborate with frontend, mobile, DevOps, architects, and QA to ensure features are delivered holistically and integrate smoothly across the platform.
Understand how backend components interact with UIs, cloud infrastructure, data stores, and external systems.
Participate in design discussions and provide input on architecture, system behavior, performance trade‑offs, and scaling strategies.
Use GitHub Copilot and other AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.
Help establish best practices for responsible, high‑value AI use within the engineering team.
Participate in experimentation and adoption of new AI‑based development workflows.
Write and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and automated test scenarios in collaboration with QA.
Profile and optimize services for performance, throughput, and scalability.
Contribute to improving observability (metrics, logs, tracing) in coordination with DevOps.
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.
Collaborate with service delivery managers to ensure smooth deployment and production behavior.
Support occasional troubleshooting efforts for complex defects or production issues.

What you have:

5+ years of experience developing backend or full‑stack software, ideally in SaaS environments.
Strong proficiency in Java, with experience in frameworks like Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Hibernate.
Ability to understand end‑to‑end system design, data flows, integration points, and how cloud‑native systems behave in production.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
Hands‑on experience with Git, build tools (Maven/Gradle), CI/CD pipelines, and modern development practices.
A mindset focused on learning, growth, and continuous improvement, including adoption of AI‑assisted development tools.
Exposure to observability tools (logs, metrics, traces) and performance debugging.
Strong communication and collaboration skills—comfortable working with cross‑functional teams.
Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent real‑world experience.

Nice to Have:

Background in identity, authentication, biometrics, cryptography, or fraud prevention.
Experience with telephony, voice biometrics, or multi‑channel communications platforms.

What we offer:

Work in the rapidly growing fields of identity verification, authentication, biometrics, telephony, and fraud.
Opportunity to influence and shape the architecture of a major SaaS platform used by global enterprise customers.
Competitive salary and benefits.
A flexible, supportive environment that respects work/life balance.

Join the brightest minds from around the globe as we build the future of digital identity!

Daon is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and supported.
