WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

WPP is embarking on a major 3-year Transformation to simplify, modernise, and unify its technology platforms across the group. This change is critical to:



- Enable cost-effective transformation and operational efficiency
- Accelerate adoption of AI, data, and digital platforms
- Ensure consistent delivery of value and benefits across all agencies and markets
- Minimise disruption and maximise engagement during large-scale change

As part of Technology Operations portfolio, you will be defining, leading and supporting one of our strategic and business impacting initiatives.

We are looking for an experienced and dedicated Senior Project Manager to ensure that these initiatives are mobilised with clear scope, governance, plans and accountabilities. Delivery milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions are managed transparently. Senior stakeholders have confidence in delivery progress and issue resolution. And that business readiness, adoption and benefits realisation are actively supported.The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading complex technology projects that deliver strategic outcomes for the organisation. This role ensures projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards, while managing risks and dependencies across multiple workstreams. Acting as a key liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, the Senior Project Manager owns and drives successful delivery, governance, fosters collaboration, and champions change adoption to maximise business value.

What you'll be doing:



- Own transformation initiatives from the Technology Operations portfolio, responsible for successful delivery.
- Plan, manage, and execute programme workstreams to time, cost, quality, and compliance standards.
- Ensure alignment with programme objectives and strategic outcomes.
- Actively manages programme risks, issues and dependencies across the transformation initiatives.
- Define and mobilise the governance model for the initiatives.
- Maintain RAID, produce status reporting, and coordinate assurance across technical and cross‑functional teams.
- Ensure adherence to Strategy and Transformation standards, tools, processes, and compliance requirements; ensuring accurate and timely reporting across governance layers.
- Act as a liaison between engineering teams, partners and WPP Technology Operations, ensuring decisions are informed and escalations handled promptly.
- Work closely with the Programme Director, Technology Operations, partners and wider Enterprise Technology and WPP.
- Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and sponsors.
- Communicate project status, risks, and decisions clearly and regularly.
- Manage project budgets, resource allocation, and vendor relationships.
- Track costs and benefits to ensure value delivery.
- Work closely with our Change & Adoption to coordinate business readiness, support planning, and ensure migration impacts are understood and managed.
- Work closely with our Change & Adoption specialists to support readiness and adoption of new technologies and processes.
- Work closely with our Change & Adoption to minimise disruption and embed change effectively across teams.
- Contribute to the Portfolio and Programme Management (PPM) community, fostering continuous learning and career progression.
- Coach and mentor project teams to embed a high-performing culture aligned with organisational values.
- Maintain accurate role assignments and project documentation.
- Support governance reporting and ensure timely updates in project management tools.

What you'll need:



- Senior project management experience in leading complex Technology / IT projects across the full delivery lifecycle, including managing multiple projects in parallel.
- Proven track record mobilising and delivering strategic, operationally complex initiatives with cross-functional internal and external teams across global or matrixed organisations.
- Strong governance, planning, RAID, reporting and stakeholder management capability.
- Experience managing budgets, vendors, dependencies and delivery risks.
- Strong leadership and influencing skills, with experience engaging and coordinating globally dispersed teams.
- Excellent communicator, able to translate complex technical information into clear, concise messages for varied stakeholders.
- Adaptable and resilient, able to respond to changing priorities and keep delivery on track under pressure.
- Strategic and commercially aware thinker, able to balance technical, operational and commercial considerations.
- Agile, waterfall or hybrid delivery experience.
- Project management qualification such as PRINCE2, PMP, MSP, AgilePM or equivalent.
- Experience in large-scale organisational change or business readiness.
- Excellent relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility, solve problems, build consensus and achieve outcomes.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

About The Job

The Managed Cloud Services team is actively searching for a manager to join our SAS Managed Cloud Delivery Management team. This role involves managing the activities and personnel responsible for providing direct SAS Managed Service Management support to both SAS employees and SAS business customers. In this position, you will offer leadership to ensure that our staff operates at peak efficiency and effectiveness.

You will support delivery, operational and success capabilities across the business that share the objective of providing the highest levels of customer service while maintaining overall financial goals in support of SAS Managed Cloud Services revenue growth and profitability. Defines and oversees the development of internal and external resources needed to meet customer and service expectations within the scope of contract.

We are looking for someone with a keen eye for continuous improvement and a passion for driving it in all aspects of the operational administrator’s team. This is an exciting opportunity to join a new and rapidly growing area within SAS globally. You will have the chance to help shape how we work in the region while supporting a variety of customers on a day-to-day basis.

As a Manager, You Will



- Team Leadership and Resource Management - Lead, mentor, and develop technical teams, ensuring they have the skills and resources to deliver on customer commitments.
- Business and Financial Acumen - Understand key business concepts that support revenue and profit growth, such as cost management, revenue forecasting, and budget adherence.
- Continuous Improvement and Innovation - Identify and implement process improvements and tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of service delivery.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate with sales, marketing, and customer success teams to align managed services with customer growth strategies.
- Reporting and Metrics - Prepare and deliver regular reports on service performance, financials, and customer satisfaction to internal and external stakeholders.
- Risk Management and Compliance - Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with cloud delivery, including security, compliance, and operational risks.
- Strategic Planning - Participate in the development of long-term strategies for managed services, ensuring alignment with company goals and market trends.
- Customer Relationship Management - Develop and maintain strong relationships with customer stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and alignment on objectives.
- Service Delivery Oversight - Lead and manage technical and operational teams responsible for the ongoing delivery and support of enterprise software in the public cloud.
- Customer Escalations and ITSM - Manage escalations, both customer-facing and internally, to drive timely and satisfactory resolutions.
- Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.
- Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

Required Qualifications



- 8+ years of experience in Information Systems within a functional area.
- Five years of experience in a leadership role includes two years in a formal management role. Three years of direct customer experience preferred. 
- Bachelor's degree preferably in Computer Science or related field.
- Demonstrated strong management and leadership skills
- Excellent technical knowledge of one or more operating systems and hardware architecture
- Excellent ability to handle multiple projects at the same time
- Excellent ability to supervise and train employees with varying skill sets in a high-pressure environment
- Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills
- Proof of right to work in work location is required to be considered for the role
- An equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications.

Additional Competencies, Knowledge And Skills



- Delegation and Empowerment - Identifying and leveraging opportunities to accelerate results and build capability by assigning tasks and decision-making responsibilities to individuals or teams with clear boundaries, expectations, support, and follow-up.
- Inspiring Others - Motivating individuals toward higher levels of performance that are aligned with the organization’s vision and values.
- Creating a Culture of Trust - Fostering a work environment that encourages people to act with integrity and treat each other and their ideas with respect; creating and protecting a high-trust environment by setting an example, advocating for others in the face of challenges, removing barriers to trust, and rewarding others for demonstrating behaviours that cultivate trust. Provides feedback both reinforcing and constructive regarding the behaviours of his/her managers.

Global Head of Long-Term Containment - Trust & Safety

Location
:

Dublin

Employment Type
:

Regular

Job Code
:

A174284

Responsibilities

About the team
Our Trust & Safety team's commitment is to keep our online community safe. We have invested heavily in human and machine-based moderation to remove harmful content quickly and often before it reaches our general community.
The Long-Term Containment team sits in the "Contain" phase of the risk lifecycle. While our Response teams optimize for speed and near-term risk reduction, Long-Term Containment optimizes for thoroughness - the implementation of durable enforcement work that prevents the same harm from resurfacing. The team owns sustained enforcement on the platform's most persistent and high-severity harms, and feeds its insights upstream to Prevention teams to drive root-cause remediation.

About the Role
As the Global Head of Long-Term Containment, you own the strategy, performance, and people of the entire Long-Term Containment function. You lead a global organization of leaders - each running a dedicated team of analysts responsible for tackling Hateful and Harassment Behavior, Violent Extremism, Youth Safety, and High-Risk Regulated Activities and Account Integrity.
This is a leader-of-leaders role. You set the global containment strategy across all prioritised harm verticals, decide where the organization invests its enforcement capacity, and are accountable for the outcomes that define the team: fewer repeat escalations, lower issue prevalence, lower discoverability, and durable enforcement that holds over time. Your team is responsible for converting escalation signals into broad, lasting mitigations rather than one-off actions.
You represent Long-Term Containment to senior Trust & Safety leadership and to cross-functional partners across Policy, Product, Operations, and Data Science, and to external safety organizations and industry bodies where relevant.
Please note that this role involves oversight of teams exposed to sensitive and potentially disturbing content spanning violent extremism, hateful behavior, youth safety, and other high-severity harms. We are committed to the well-being of our people and provide comprehensive wellness and resilience support to every member of the team.

Key Responsibilities
- Own the global long-term containment strategy across all prioritised harm verticals -e.g. Hateful and Harassment Behavior, Violent Extremism and Dangerous Actors, Youth Safety, and High-Risk Regulated Activities and Account Integrity
- Lead, develop, and grow a team of leaders who each manage a team of individual contributor analysts; coach your leaders, build the bench, and hold a consistent bar for performance and delivery across regions.
- Drive delivery for the function's headline outcomes, escalation reduction, prevalence, discoverability, and recidivism, and ensure the team is on track.
- Own and evolve the Long-Term Containment operating model, including the trend-led containment cycle, so escalation signals are expanded into long term mitigations rather than handled ticket by ticket.
- Partner with the Prevention teams to close the containment gaps their root cause analyses surface. Feed enforcement insight and signals back upstream to drive systemic, root-cause fixes across Policy, Product, and Operations.
- Represent the team to senior leadership, cross-functional partners, and external safety organizations and coalitions, shaping risk-mitigation strategy at scale and securing the alignment and resources the function needs.
- Drive operational rigor across roadmap, OKRs, and headcount planning, and champion the well-being, resilience, and well being best practices of a team exposed to sensitive content.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, Risk, or adjacent integrity domains
- 5+ years of experience managing managers and leading larger organisations across multiple regions.
- Demonstrated experience owning enforcement or risk strategy across several harm areas at scale, with a clear record of shipping systemic, long-term mitigations.
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional teams, and represent a function to external partners.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Strong data fluency, with the ability to partner with Data Science, Product and Engineering teams and to set the metrics and measurement approach while also driving our tooling roadmap.
- Experience building or scaling a Trust & Safety, enforcement, or investigations organization - hiring leaders, standing up operating models, and standardizing methodology across regions.
- Direct experience across two or more of the team's harm domains - organized hate and harassment, violent extremism and dangerous organizations, youth safety, or regulated activities and account integrity - with clear accountability for durable outcomes rather than ticket-level handling.
- Demonstrated experience embedding AI and LLM tooling into Trust & Safety workflows, with measurable gains in analyst throughput, enforcement precision, or detection of adversarial content.

Job Information

Trust & Safety

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis.

​

​

TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining.

​

​

We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.

​

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

​

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

​

​

Diversity & Inclusion

​

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

We’re a growing global tech company, with huge potential for curious and caring minds, committed to each other, to deliver solutions that protect people and the planet for future generations. Our team of experts are focused on creating meaningful impact and making a real difference for our customers.

About The Role

As our Product Owner you will play a key role in delivering safety-critical software used by emergency services, government agencies, corporate resilience and business continuity teams when it matters most.

Sitting within our Product Operations team, you will own day-to-day product delivery for D4H, translating approved roadmap initiatives into high-quality, measurable and supportable software deliverables. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, QA and operational stakeholders to ensure teams have the clarity, direction and product decisions needed to deliver effectively.

This is an opportunity to help evolve a trusted, proven platform as it scales into new markets and connects into EcoOnline’s broader EcoOne platform, including identity, data and analytics, and dedicated AI platform services.

You will play a key role in helping EcoOnline move customers from compliance to visibility to prediction, with AI becoming a first-class capability that supports crisis readiness, incident response and operational resilience.

Key Responsibilities



- Translate roadmap initiatives into deliverable product solutions, increments, epics, features and user stories.
- Own backlog quality and prioritisation, ensuring engineering teams have clear, actionable and well-defined requirements.
- Use AI day-to-day to accelerate specification writing, backlog grooming, data analysis and QA acceptance.
- Work closely with Product Management and Engineering to shape solutions that balance customer needs, technical constraints and delivery timelines.
- Manage delivery scope while protecting agreed objectives, escalating significant changes where strategic decisions are required.
- Provide timely product direction throughout delivery, resolving day-to-day questions around execution, operations and implementation.
- Coordinate release readiness, including documentation, release notes, operational preparation and successful deployment.
- Define clear acceptance criteria, support testing and quality assurance, and ensure delivered capabilities can be measured after release.
- Use customer feedback and product data to support continuous improvement and maintain high product quality.
- Factor AI governance, data-handling considerations and model limitations into product design, acceptance criteria and delivery decisions. 

What We're Looking For



- 2+ years’ experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager delivering software products.
- Fluent, practical and daily use of AI tools to write specs, groom backlogs, analyse information and move faster.
- Demonstrated technical fluency, with the ability to work confidently with Engineering and Architecture teams.
- Experience influencing without authority and driving decisions across multiple R&D teams or stakeholder groups.
- Experience shipping AI-built or AI-designed product features, with an understanding of what makes an AI capability production-ready, trustworthy and usable in high-stakes environments.
- Strong backlog and delivery management skills across epics, stories, acceptance criteria and the software development lifecycle.
- Comfortable working with technical concepts such as APIs, data models and system architecture.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities across internal teams.
- Working knowledge of AI and LLM concepts, such as prompting, RAG, model limitations and evaluation.
- Awareness of AI governance, data sensitivity and compliance considerations in regulated, multi-region product environments.
- Ideally, experience in public safety, emergency management, crisis or business continuity, or other safety-critical or mission-critical software environments.
- Curiosity, pace and commercial awareness, with the ability to understand the “why” behind product decisions and keep delivery moving.

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Growth Team 👋

Organic Search sits at the heart of Trainline's Growth team, helping millions of travellers discover Europe's leading independent rail and coach platform through both traditional search and the fast-evolving world of generative AI engines. As Europe's number one downloaded rail app, we're on a mission to make travel as simple, seamless and affordable as it should be, and this role plays a genuine part in getting us seen and found by the people who need us.

You'll work closely with the Organic Search leadership team, shaping how Trainline shows up across search engines and AI-generated answers alike, while collaborating with technical SEO, engineering, marketing and go-to-market colleagues. It's a role with real scope to influence visibility strategy and get hands-on with both the craft of content and the emerging discipline of GEO.

In this role as the Senior Organic Search Executive, you will...🚄

 - Conduct keyword and topic research covering both traditional search intent and conversational AI queries, and use it to shape meta titles, descriptions, H1s and on-page content

 - Create and publish editorial content and landing page copy optimised for both SEO and GEO, in line with Trainline's brand tone of voice

 - Check content and copywriting regularly for local accuracy and effectiveness

 - Identify and flag technical issues affecting content visibility, crawling, indexing and AI crawler access, working with technical SEO and engineering to resolve them

 - Monitor competitor performance across search and generative engines, tracking visibility and citation share to spot content gaps and inform decisions

 - Own strategies to grow Trainline's visibility and citation share in generative engines, from spotting opportunities through to delivery

 - Keep on top of the fast-moving AI search landscape and share relevant updates with the wider team

 - Partner with other marketing channels and go-to-market teams to build a localised SEO and GEO content roadmap

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

 - Fluency in English, as this role focuses on supporting English-speaking markets

 - Experience working in Enterprise SEO and executing organic search strategies

 - Positive attitude, growth mindset, flexible and can work collaboratively.

 - An understanding of how search engines crawl, index and rank content, alongside a working knowledge of how generative engines source and cite information

 - Familiarity with structured data and schema markup to improve visibility for both search engines and AI consumption

 - Confidence using analytics tools such as Google Search Console and Google Analytics, and you're happy to pick up new tools as needed

 - Experience with SEO and GEO tools such as SEMRush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Ahrefs or Profound would be helpful

 - A curious, proactive approach to using AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working

 - Strong written communication and copywriting skills, with the ability to bring creative solutions to complex SEO and GEO challenges

 - Comfort working across a CMS platform, managing multiple deadlines, and reporting on KPIs in a fast-paced environment



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainline/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeattrainline/ and Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Trainline-EI_IE249203.11,20.htm!

About Beamery

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Deepening our native integrations with SAP, Workday, Microsoft, and LinkedIn to seamlessly embed our skills intelligence into the platforms where critical workforce decisions are made.

Embedding our agentic AI to help customers plan smarter for the future—powering workforce strategies, internal mobility, and skills forecasting.

Advancing our use of proprietary LLMs and knowledge graph technology to help organizations unlock broader talent pools, make fairer decisions, and expand access to opportunity at scale.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

Responsibilities



- Build and maintain reporting that product managers, engineering leads, and the exec team actually use to tell stories and make decisions. This includes recurring dashboards in Hex as well as one-off analyses in response to specific product questions.
- Partner directly with PMs across the portfolio (Talent CRM, Work Architecture, Work Intelligence) to answer product questions such as usage, adoption, retention, feature performance, conversion through key flows.
- Maintain the product analytics tool stack (incl. Pendo, and Hex). Make sure they're configured well, integrated properly, and that PMs and designers can get to the answers they need without always going through you.
- Enable PMs to self-serve. Build the dashboards, templates, and documentation that mean routine questions don't need an analyst in the loop. Your job is to make yourself unnecessary for the easy stuff so you can focus on the hard stuff.
- Design and iterate AI agent workflows to automate prospecting, outreach, lead qualification, and follow-up
- Leverage LLM-powered tools to build scalable, autonomous product ops processes (e.g. customer and market feedback ops, roadmap and planning, process and governance, internal communication and team enablement)
- Instrument agents with feedback loops and quality controls
- Evaluate emerging AI tooling and document agent architectures so workflows are reproducible and maintainable

What We're Looking For



- Strong SQL. You'll be writing it daily, against messy real-world data, and you should be comfortable doing so as a stand-alone SME.
- A track record in product analytics, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally somewhere with multiple products or a reasonably complex data model.
- Hands-on experience with Pendo or a comparable product analytics tool (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap), and with a SQL-based exploration tool like Hex, Mode, or similar.
- You can tell a clear story with data such as building a dashboard that doesn't need a tour, or present a finding to a PM or a VP with strong clarity and focus.
- Pragmatism. Beamery's data isn't pristine. We need someone who can make progress in a real environment in the face of imperfect conditions.
- Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered automation workflows - either in a business or personal context

Nice to have



- Experience analysing AI/ML-powered product features.
- Exposure to HR tech, talent acquisition, or workforce data.

Beamery is for Everybody. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to us. We acknowledge the challenges in our industry and strive to develop an inclusive culture where everybody can contribute. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, or caregiver status. If, for whatever reason, you need us to make reasonable adjustments and adaptations to our recruitment process, please email accommodations@beamery.com

Visit our Diversity, Equality and Inclusion page to learn more about progress and commitments.

A Software Developer Engineer in Penrose Networks at AWS owns the design and development of key components of Amazon’s next-generation datacenter network.

This includes building tools to provide network visibility to a wide range of internal operators, and systems to automate wiring and incremental expansion of DC networks, globally. You will collaborate with Network Engineering, DC Operations, and with a wide range of teams operating provisioning, configuration, deployment, monitoring and scaling tools.

Develop world-class software systems for automating Amazon's network.
Provide technical direction to the team and identify areas of focus.
Create and review software design documentation
Collaborate with Principal Engineers and Scholars to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products.
Own the operational excellence of the software you put into production.
Contribute to improving our documentation, processes, and tools so that we improve our performance as a team.

A day in the life
You will have frontier coding agents with unlimited tokens.

About the team
Penrose Networks is the next-generation datacenter network in AWS. Through a novel architecture based on special mathematical properties, we deliver more resilient, higher-bandwidth, and lower-cost networking compared to the current industry standard. Our team has invented this technology, proven its viability, and driven its adoption across AWS. We are currently working to further enlarge the adoption of this technology to a wider set of use cases and locations.

We are a tiger team. We are disruptors. Our team owns the network, software, and program management aspects that make this next-gen network a reality.

- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

- Ability to produce high output of high-quality code by overseeing multiple AI agents

- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Knowledge of the tools of the trade, including a variety of modern programming languages (Rust, Java, C/C++), and a solid understanding of the Linux operating system

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. Who Are We?

We insure small businesses and enable big dreams – not just for our customers, but for our people and communities too. With over 1,000,000 active insurance policies, we protect builders, bakers, landlords and more than 1,200 other trades.

We’re a technology company as well as one that sells insurance. That means we build, we fail, we learn and we improve. Through our global social impact strategy, called 'The Big Dreams Project’, we're working to help 10,000 small businesses start or grow by 2030.

Why not check out our advert on YouTube: Simply Business TV advert 2024: 'Simply the Best'.

Job Category

Project Management

Position Type

Permanent

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

Here's What You'll Be Doing

Most organisations treat process optimisation as a side project. At Simply Business, we see it as the engine of our tech strategy. We're looking for a Delivery Operations Lead to step into our Shared Services department and transform how we buildMost organisations treat flow of work as a side project. At Simply Business, we see it as the engine of our tech strategy. We are looking for a highly analytical and collaborative Delivery Operations Lead with a software or data engineering background to join our Shared Services department. Reporting to the Delivery Manager, you will act as a systems-thinking champion to optimise the flow of work.

The Delivery Operations Lead partners with Product and Engineering managers to implement global practices, identify systemic risks, and reduce waste. By optimising throughput, this role stabilises, then accelerates time-to-market and minimises operational costs.

As One Of Our Delivery Operations Leads, You'll



- Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen practices to overhaul end-to-end workflows and eliminate system-wide bottlenecks.
- Build and maintain dynamic workflow maps that expose blockers, highlight opportunities, and map out broader system impacts.
- Standardise and automate tools across Shared Services to streamline our discovery and software delivery lifecycles.
- Analyse core flow metrics (throughput, lead time, cycle time) to root out underlying issues and drive data-backed recommendations.
- Harness Jira, developer tooling, and BI platforms (like Looker or Tableau) to visualise process health and quantify the impact of change.
- Empower teams through self-service tooling, peer training, and data advocacy to embed a continuous-improvement mindset.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is



- Experienced in process mastery, with an expert grasp of Lean, Six Sigma, or Theory of Constraints applied directly to software delivery.
- Tech-minded at heart, with 2+ years of hands-on experience as a data or software engineer, alongside strong Jira administration skills.
- Skilled in data visualisation, capable of turning complex datasets into clear insights using tools like Tableau or Looker.
- A strategic communicator who can translate operational data into executive-level narratives that influence leadership without relying on direct authority.
- Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable cutting through ambiguity to bring clarity to fast-paced, evolving environments.
- An intentional collaborator and conscious change agent who values diverse perspectives, self-awareness, and guiding teams smoothly through growth.

"(We know it's tough, but please try to avoid the confidence gap. You don't have to match all the bullet points above to be considered for this role.)

We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you and do your very best work."

Ready to build systems that actually scale?

If you're an engineer at heart who loves untangling complex systemic puzzles, this is your sandbox. At Simply Business, we don't just tolerate optimisation — we rely on it to ship impactful software to hundreds of thousands of small businesses. You will have the autonomy, modern stack, and data-rich environment to build elegant, automated workflows that keep high-performing teams moving fast. No jargon, no rigid hierarchy — just real systems impact, high-throughput delivery, and an inclusive culture that values your engineering perspective.

Apply today and help us reshape how we deliver tech at scale!

What Are The Benefits Of Working At Simply Business



- we offer a great work-life balance where workloads are manageable and everyone has the flexibility to work hybrid
- on top of the 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), we offer the option to buy five more days of holiday with your flexible benefits
- our flexible parental leave allows you to approach an important time how you want - with six months full pay to the primary caregiver and four weeks full pay if you're the secondary caregiver
- our life event leave is an extra days leave every two years for those big moments in your life like moving house or your birthday. And our long-serving employees get a two week paid sabbatical after five years of service, then four weeks off after ten years of service
- private medical insurance through BUPA, that covers any pre-existing condition is a core benefit. Plus a health cash plan that covers your everyday medical expenses
- we offer a competitive salary based on your experience and the current market. Plus the potential to earn an annual bonus based on performance
- access to tools to support your personal development on our dedicated learning platform. As well as support for your mental health with access to counselling
- we match what you put into your pension up to five per cent. And pass on a tax-free sum that's four times your basic salary with our life assurance policy, with the option to increase it to ten times through our flexible benefit scheme
- our salary sacrifice car scheme gives you the option to buy a brand new, fully insured, and maintained car for a convenient fixed monthly amount taken from your gross salary (after 6 months service)
- our flexible benefits scheme gives you an allocated amount to use each year on benefits like critical illness cover, dental insurance, travel insurance, or a gym membership

Ready to join us and drive our success as a high-performing team? Apply today.

The Network Delivery team is responsible for designing, building, and scaling telecommunications infrastructure to support Amazon’s Fulfillment infrastructure in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

We are seeking a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to manage the design , acquisition and deployment of telecommunications services to support scaling and development of the Fulfillment Center Networks. This role will require market knowledge to develop market strategies that are operationally stable, scalable yet frugal. You will work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to develop project ideas into project plans, helping balance customer requirements with team requirements. You actively participate in design reviews, operational reviews, architecture discussions, and team planning. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions.

You work directly with vendors, customers, partner teams, and (as needed) engineering teams. Multiple team goals and program-related metrics, impacting a region.

Optimizes cross-team processes to improve efficiency and delivery.

This is an opportunity to join Ascot Group - one of the world’s preeminent specialty risk underwriting organizations.

Designed as a modern-era company operating through an ecosystem of interconnected global operating platforms, we’re bound by a common mission and purpose: One Ascot. Our greatest strength is a talented team who flourish in a collaborative, inclusive, and entrepreneurial culture, steeped in underwriting excellence, integrity, and a passion to find a better way, The Ascot Way.

The Ascot Way guides our people and our organization. Our underwriting platforms collaborate to find creative ways to deploy our capital in a true cross-product and cross-platform approach. These platforms work as one, deploying our capital creatively through our unique Fusion Model: Client Centric, Risk Centric, Technology Centric.

Built to be resilient, Ascot maximizes client financial security while delivering bespoke products and world class service — both pre- and post-claims. Ascot exists to solve for our clients’ brightest tomorrow, through agility, collaboration, resilience, and discipline.

Job Purpose



-  Establish yourself as the product expert and go-to person for understanding the various Underwriting Products including but not limited to, applications, warehouses, methodologies, and reporting solutions. 
-  Tackle operational issues, mitigate risks, and seek opportunities for process improvement or automation, while staying updated on technical and regulatory changes affecting Underwriting Operations. 
-  Oversee the sequencing of operational and IT updates within Underwriting, ensuring project outcomes align with goals, and orchestrating the Underwriting team’s engagement in business-wide operational change. 
-  Continually monitor and update Underwriting business processes, ensuring they are evaluated regularly and adapted to reflect any changes as a result of I.T Initiatives. 
-  Work closely with the Director of Operational Strategy to ensure any Underwriting initiatives align to Ascots strategic objectives and the required prioritisation has been applied. 
-  Help develop the Product Management capability, with a focus on developing core competencies and cultivating a culture of ‘continuous improvement. 

Detailed Duties



-  Undertake a continuous review of the existing products, identifying areas for improvement, and making recommendations to provide better outcomes for the Underwriting teams. 
-  Assist in troubleshooting and investigating operational issues that arise within Underwriting, helping propose and work through potential solutions. 
-  Proactively identify potential operational risks within Underwriting, ensuring all risks are monitored, actioned and if possible mitigated. 
-  Work with the Underwriting teams to analyse business processes and workflows identifying areas for improvement or automation. 
-  Familiarise yourself with technical and regulatory changes to understand how they might impact the Underwriting landscape. 
-  Provide technical support to the business on behalf of Underwriting, including acting as a SME on projects, participating in workshops and contributing to project delivery as required. 
-  Build strong working relationships with key stakeholders across the business including but not limited to Operations, I.T, Finance, Reinsurance, Claims, Pricing and Actuarial. 
-  Perform any required analysis to support and promote the funding of all discretionary initiatives on behalf of the Underwriting teams. 
-  Oversee and assist in the monitoring and achievement of any Underwriting project benefits, confirming their alignment with the initial business case objectives. 
-  Facilitate the prioritisation of all operational and IT changes within the Underwriting business area, by co-ordinating the Underwriting teams across large-scale transformation projects, handling small change service requests, and contributing to the ongoing development of data warehouses. 
-  Develop, implement, and manage OKRs and KPIs for the Underwriting teams to align with Ascots strategic objectives. 
-  Assist the Director of Operational Strategy with any ad-hoc requests when needed. 

Person Specification



-  Serve as the liaison between Underwriting and IT, effectively translating technical solutions into non-technical language and vice versa. 
-  Able to facilitate, collaborate, influence and drive resolution across different stakeholders within the Ascot Group. 
-  Proactive and organised with good attention to detail. 
-  Lead by example at all times. 
-  Highly professional, energetic, diplomatic, calm, pragmatic and solution-driven. 
-  Exceptional problem-solving skills. 
-  Self-sufficient and a self-starter who can think and act proactively. 
-  A willingness to be flexible and respond appropriately to changing and / or conflicting demands. 

Technical Knowledge



-  Understanding of Underwriting concepts and accounting principles. Including knowledge of the various types of MOA’s, Contracts Types and Business Classes. 
-  Well versed in Business Process Improvement (BPI) methodologies, with experience of enhancing operational processes. 
-  Experience with process mapping tools and techniques, with a background of producing As-Is and To-Be process documentation. 
-  Skilled in evaluating and writing new proposals for the purpose of obtaining new project funding. 
-  Adept in formulating and executing SQL queries for data manipulation and analysis. 
-  Knowledge of Risk Management strategies to identify, assess and prioritise risks. 
-  Familiarity with the full Project Lifecycle, including experience in different methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid) 
-  Strong Microsoft skills in particular Excel, Visio, Powerpoint, Word and Outlook. 
-  Ability to review Project plans, Resource allocation and Benefit Realisation models. 

Business Knowledge



-  Lloyd’s Market, General Insurance or Broking Experience (Must Have) 
-  Core concepts of Insurance – Underwriting, Reinsurance, Finance, Compliance, Claims (Must Have) 
-  Background in Underwriting or Underwriting Operations from either BAU or Project based activities (Must Have)

About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

About the Role

This role provides the opportunity to lead significant components of a high-profile global transformation of investor onboarding, shaping future processes, controls, data, technology and operating models across regions and platforms.

The Specialist will apply deep transformation and business expertise to lead complex workstreams, solve challenging problems and translate strategy into delivery. The role will work across operations, technology, product, risk and control partners to improve service delivery, strengthen controls and support implementation of the global target operating model.

Why Apply

The role offers direct exposure to senior forums, cross-regional delivery and strategic decision-making, with accountability for complex transformation outcomes and the opportunity to influence priorities, implementation approaches and adoption.

It provides the chance to make a visible contribution to better client outcomes, stronger controls and more consistent ways of working across a core global capability. This is an opportunity to lead meaningful components of a global transformation, influence strategic decisions and support delivery of a more consistent, controlled and scalable investor onboarding model.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be an experienced transformation professional with strong judgement, analytical capability and the confidence to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders. They will take ownership, manage ambiguity, challenge constructively and convert complex issues into practical recommendations and executable plans. They will build strategic relationships, influence decisions and provide work leadership without formal supervisory responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

Transformation Strategy & Workstream Leadership

Lead multiple complex transformation processes, programmes or workstreams aligned to global investor onboarding priorities and business objectives.

Shape implementation approaches and translate transformation strategy into clear plans, decisions, milestones and measurable outcomes.

Lead significant components of target operating model design and implementation, including process, control, data, technology and organisational change considerations.

Coordinate activities, dependencies, risks and resources across stakeholders to deliver agreed outcomes on time and within scope.

Apply knowledge of business drivers and departmental priorities to recommend improvements to performance, service delivery, operational effectiveness and transformation progress.

Analysis, Problem Solving & Solution Delivery

Assess complex or less-defined issues, evaluate multiple business, operational, data, control and regulatory considerations, and identify innovative, practical solutions.

Lead and support current-state assessment, gap analysis, solution evaluation and future-state definition across investor onboarding, transfer agency and AML/KYC processes.

Use data and evidence to test assumptions, identify root causes and support informed decision-making.

Exercise discretion within functional policies to adapt approaches, improve processes and resolve escalated transformation issues.

Support implementation readiness, testing, change execution, adoption and post-implementation review.

Stakeholder Engagement, Governance & Communication

Build strategic working relationships with peers, senior staff and cross-functional partners across operations, technology, product, risk and compliance.

Facilitate senior workshops and working sessions to align priorities, resolve issues, support decisions and maintain delivery momentum.

Communicate findings, recommendations, risks, dependencies and progress clearly through governance materials, presentations and executive updates.

Influence stakeholders and senior functional partners to secure alignment and support execution across regional and global teams.

Contribute to functional planning and budget-related activities by providing input aligned to transformation priorities and strategy.

Subject Matter Leadership & Continuous Improvement

Provide subject matter guidance, direction and work leadership to colleagues on complex transformation activities.

Improve transformation standards, governance, controls, templates and ways of working across the portfolio.

Promote effective knowledge transfer, consistent execution and sustainable adoption of improved processes, tools and operating models.

Perform all duties in accordance with established policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.

Essential Skills & Qualifications

Specialised depth and breadth of experience in transformation, change delivery, investor onboarding, transfer agency, AML/KYC, funds or financial services operations.

Proven ability to lead complex functional projects or workstreams with moderate risk, resource requirements and cross-functional dependencies.

Advanced analytical, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to develop practical solutions in less-defined situations.

Strong understanding of business drivers, operating models, controls, service delivery and regulatory considerations.

Confident stakeholder leadership, including the ability to influence peers and senior staff, facilitate workshops and communicate complex matters clearly.

Sound judgement and decision-making skills when balancing policy, business needs, risk and delivery priorities.

Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with experience producing executive and governance materials.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office is essential. Experience with Visio, Power BI, SharePoint, Aha!, Azure DevOps, Jira or Confluence is beneficial.

Bachelor’s or university degree required; advanced degree preferred. Typically 8+ years of relevant experience. Relevant change, project, process improvement or Agile certification is beneficial.

Work Authorization

Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

Join us to help lead the next wave of the digital economy.

The world depends on the infrastructure that keeps us connected. From the way we work to how we live, every moment depends on it. Yet most of that infrastructure sits in the same crowded hubs, running up against constraints of space, power and permits. That’s where you come in.

At Apto, we design, build and operate hyperscale data centres where they’re needed most - in Europe’s fastest-growing markets, working with customers to unblock capacity bottlenecks. These are the places our customers need to be next, where land and power can be unlocked and where growth is possible - so the digital economy can thrive.

You’ll join a business formed to develop and operate the European data centre assets of global investment manager PIMCO and we benefit from the scale, resources and land sourcing capabilities of one of the largest real estate platforms in Europe.

We have the firepower to deliver - but it’s our people who make the difference: a leadership team behind some of the most ambitious data centre projects in the world, and colleagues who will push you, back you and bring you into the decisions that shape our future. From day one, we’ve been deliberate about the company we’re building - values-led, customer-obsessed and ambitious for each other’s success.

If you want to work somewhere you can see the direct impact of what you do, this is your moment. At Apto, we don’t just build data centres. We build careers, capabilities and a culture where everyone owns the outcome.

The role

Due to our rapidly growing portfolio of work, we are now seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to coordinate the end-to-end delivery of large-scale data centre design and construction programs across Europe, from early design through construction, commissioning, and customer handover.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical knowledge of data centre infrastructure and proven experience delivering complex programs for a hyperscale cloud operator, colocation provider, or major vendor.

Key Responsibilities Of This Role Include



- Coordination of the full data centre delivery lifecycle from design through to customer occupation.
- Coordination of cross-functional teams covering design, power delivery, permitting, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover.
- Supporting the engineering teams with design-phase activities including electrical, mechanical, and power architecture
- Supporting the wider team with power and utilities coordination, including grid connections, build and energisation.
- Working with our internal teams to track permitting, regulatory approvals, and associated schedule risk across European jurisdictions.

*Sales Representative – Automotive Technology*
Radio King · Rosemount Business Park, Dublin · Full-time, permanent, on-site
*€32,000 – €36,000 base + uncapped commission · OTE €48,000+*

Radio King is one of Ireland's specialists in car Android systems and automotive electronics. We install Android head units, reverse and dash cameras, speakers and subwoofers, and we handle Japanese import conversions — FM band, CarPlay and Android Auto activation, firmware.

We supply and fit premium equipment for main dealer groups, independent garages and private clients across Ireland. The team is 20 people and the order book is growing faster than we can process it. That's why this role exists: the enquiries are already coming in, and we need someone who can turn them into booked work and keep the dealer accounts growing.

*What you'll do*

* Convert inbound enquiries from phone, email and chat into booked jobs — we generate the leads, you close them
* Open new dealer and garage accounts, including outbound calls to a targeted list
* Quote and upsell: match the right system and options to the vehicle and the budget
* Own your orders end to end — status, updates, delivery dates, satisfied customer
* Visit dealer clients on site and bring what you hear back to the workshop

*What we're looking for*

* 2+ years in sales, ideally B2B, automotive, aftermarket or parts
* A track record you can talk through: targets you hit and how you hit them
* Comfortable picking up the phone to someone who isn't expecting your call
* Confident with CRM and Excel, and quick to pick up new systems
* Fluent English, plus Russian or Ukrainian — our workshop and internal communication run in Russian, so this is essential for the role
* Full clean B driving licence — you'll be visiting dealers around Dublin and beyond
* Right to work in Ireland

*What we offer*

* Uncapped commission on every sale — your ceiling is your own
* 20 days annual leave
* Employee discount on equipment and installation
* Food allowance and sick pay
* Product training across every platform we work with, from stock head units to full JDM conversions
* Real progression — we're growing, and this role can lead to Sales Manager

*How to apply*
Send your CV to sales@radioking.ie and tell us, in a few sentences: a garage owner already buys head units from another supplier. What do you say in the first 30 seconds of the call?

We reply to every applicant within 5 working days.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From €32,000.00 per year

Benefits:
* Employee discount
* Food allowance
* Profit sharing
* Sick pay



Application question(s):
* Describe one sale you closed that you're proud of — what was the product, the value, and what made it happen?
* A garage owner already buys head units from another supplier. What do you say in the first 30 seconds of the call?
* Which CRM or order systems have you used, and what did you use them for?
* Can you accept the crucial role with a huge amount of responsibility? Your failure can mean a whole team failure.

Language:
* Russian/Ukrainian (required)

Licence/Certification:
* B Driving Licence (required)

Work Location: In person
